jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Us:


**VOALA**


***Helping Our Most Vulnerable Change Their Life Stories***


Volunteers of America is a non\-profit human services organization committed to serving people in need, strengthening families, and building communities. VOALA provides a variety of social services to Los Angeles area communities such as Head Start programs, Upward Bound college prep programs, veterans’ services, homeless shelters, low\-income housing program as well as drug and alcohol rehabilitation. Learn more at www.voala.org.


**PAY RATE:** $65208 \- $68640 Per Year

  

  

**BENEFITS:** VOALA offers competitive medical, dental, vision and retirement benefits.


**JOB SUMMARY AND PURPOSE**


The Project Coordinator is responsible for meeting the program goals, annually. The Program Goals for the participants served by the Project Coordinator are:


* Enroll and complete in a rigorous high school program of study
* Achieve High School graduation
* Improve academic performance on standardized tests, and competitive scores on college entrance exams
* Enrollment in post\-secondary education
* Promote college degree attainment in six years


The Project Coordinator will ensure the annual enrollment goal of 500 participants is met by January of each year


**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Supervise, evaluate and recommend staff for hire
* Collect and submit data for the annual preparation and submission of the Annual Performance Report (APR)
* Monitor and document participant academic progress and ensure a plan of action for improvement
* Visit target school and maintain contact with school personnel to develop awareness of program services and report participant’s progress
* Develop and implement a summer enrichment program
* Develop and implement tutoring math program for RSSP participants
* Responsible for meeting recruitment deadline, the assessment of participant needs, and that each student meets the requirements for enrollment in our ETS Program
* Ensure the completion of all program forms, and the appropriate documentation of all services
* Monitor and document participant academic progress and ensure a plan of action for improvement
* Visit target school and maintain contact with school personnel to develop awareness of program services and report participant progress
* Ensure the collaboration with other youth programs in the community
* Maintain accurate program files for participants in the database and file cabinets
* Develop resource educational materials for project use with seminars and workshops
* Administer and interpret project assessment inventories for participants
* Ensure the appropriate number of contacts with participants are made for college preparation, and social/personal development
* Develop and implement a summer enrichment program
* Plan and conduct parent workshops
* Plan and implement college or career tours
* Ensure that the management of participant case load is continuously being documented to reflect the provision of services
* Other duties as required


**ESSENTIAL ABILITY ACKNOWLEDGEMENT**


Ability to work and deal with difficult, uncooperative, and potentially aggressive clients as VOALA serves the neediest of the needy in our programs, which may include clients with homelessness, mental illness, substance abuse, recently released from incarceration, and other challenges.


**ESSENTIAL DUTIES:**


* Services for this position must be provided on\-site. As a result, the position requires incumbents to report to work on\-site each day of active employment.
* Responsible for day\-to\-day Program efforts, providing guidance and supervision for staff, budget oversight, project timelines, and anticipated outcomes; Effectively plans workload of subordinate individuals and programs; budgets, deploys, and organizes resources
* Recruit participants, perform outreach to school and community
* Develop curriculum and conduct workshops/seminars on college and career planning, financial literacy and personal development
* Coordinate tutorial services available at the target school and community, observe effectiveness, make referrals as appropriate
* Plan and supervise group activities and college visits, assist program activities and field trips
* Engage personally with students, prepare and execute intervention plan for poor academic performance, initiate discipline if needed, involve parents, make referrals to outside resources
* Maintain Blumen database on participants, and program schedule; prepare and record weekly evaluations, observing student privacy
* Make regular reports to Director, assist in preparation of Program’s Annual Performance Report
* Other duties as required and may be subject to change


**MANDATED REPORTER**

As service providers to the underprivileged and vulnerable in our community, all employees are considered Mandated Reporters, and must report any instance of physical or sexual abuse to proper authorities.


Qualifications


**REQUIREMENTS:**


* Must be able to pass a fingerprint clearance, background check, including criminal history, personal references, employment and education verifications
* Ability to perform under circumstances of possible emotional stress and conflicts dealing with difficult, uncooperative, and potentially aggressive clients as VOALA serves the neediest of the needy in our programs which may include clients with homelessness, mental\-illness, substance abuse, recently released from incarceration and other challenges.


**EDUCATION:**


* Bachelor’s degree required in education, counseling, social work, higher education administration, or an appropriate field related to Project objectives.


**EXPERIENCE:**


* Minimum of two (2\) years of experience assisting with staff supervision; budget management; program development and evaluation, reporting, and compliance with federal regulations.
* Minimum of four (4\) years of experience with federal TRIO programs, academic support programs, or similar programs for disadvantag

jobs.title: ALA Shared Housing Program Coordinator VISTA
jobs.description:
ALA's Shared Housing program, established in 1978, has run continuously for 45 years and matched over 2500 individuals in home share arrangements. Shared Housing has been lauded by civic leaders as an effective alternative to traditional affordable housing. The program is intended to match 1\) seniors who own their homes, live alone, and wish to remain in their homes instead of institutionalization (a nursing home) with 2\) low\-income housing seekers (renters) who need affordable rent. Exchanges may be straight rent or a mix of rent plus up to 10 hours a week in light services such as transportation, cooking, or cleaning. Rental arrangements average $700 a month and services arrangements average $200/month plus services. The average duration of each match is 2 years with the longest match at 10\+ years. Our eldest participant, Shirley, who is 105 years old, was featured in Vice News' report about ALA's Shared Housing program. You may find the video here: https://youtu.be/KeIm2zBYRoM?si\=ehr\-OMBkKp9la\_Nm  

  

  

**Member Duties :** 1\) ) Develop Reporting and Evaluation Systems \- Create reporting tools and evaluation processes that measure housing placements, retention, and participant demographics. 2\) Build Sustainable Outreach Infrastructure \- Develop systems and materials to expand outreach capacity with landlords, home providers, and referral partners. Build tools that sustain engagement and increase access to affordable housing options for low\-income residents. 3\) Strengthen Shared Housing Systems and Workflows \- Design and document efficient workflows for intake, matching, and program coordination. Improve data accuracy, streamline communication, and reduce time to\-placement to help more low\-income Angelenos achieve stable housing.
  

  

**Program Benefits :** Training , Relocation Allowance , Choice of Education Award or End of Service Stipend , Living Allowance , Childcare assistance if eligible , Health Coverage\* .

Permits attendance at school during off hours , Permits working at another job during off hours .

**Skills :**
  

Non\-Profit Management , Public Speaking , General Skills , Team Work , Community Organization .

This position is responsible for coordinating the day\-to\-day activities of the residency program and ensuring that educational, administrative, regulatory, and compliance requirements are completed accurately and within established timelines. Key responsibilities include coordinating resident recruitment and interview activities; managing resident onboarding, scheduling, credentialing, licensure, evaluations, examinations, and professional development activities; coordinating conferences, didactic sessions, skills labs, and other educational programs; and maintaining accurate resident and program records across institutional and regulatory systems. The position also supports accreditation activities, program data management, required reporting, program meetings, affiliation agreements, and communications with residents, faculty, affiliated training sites, alumni, and external organizations.
The successful candidate will manage confidential information with discretion and demonstrate strong organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills. The position requires the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet strict deadlines, work independently, and collaborate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders. jobs.description:
**Overview**

The Niles Foundation (TNF) is a community\-based nonprofit organization working to advance environmental justice, food security, clean mobility, climate resilience, economic opportunity, and community well\-being.

Through initiatives such as the Halo Food Project, EVCLEAN15, community engagement programs, leadership development efforts, and climate resilience initiatives, TNF works alongside residents, partners, and stakeholders to create meaningful opportunities and lasting community impact.***\*\*\*Only serious candidates apply.***

**Position Summary**

The Strategic Operations Coordinator supports the daily operations and organizational activities of The Niles Foundation.

This role helps maintain organizational continuity by supporting communications, community engagement activities, events, administrative functions, and operational coordination across TNF initiatives. The Strategic Operations Coordinator works closely with the Director and team members to help ensure that projects, partnerships, events, and organizational priorities continue moving forward efficiently.

This position is ideal for someone who is dependable, organized, eager to learn, able to work independently, and enjoys being part of a collaborative team environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Administrative \& Organizational Support*

* Coordinate meetings and scheduling.
* Maintain organized digital files and records.
* Track action items, deadlines, and follow\-up tasks.
* Maintain contact lists and organizational databases.
* Assist with data entry and general administrative support.
* Help ensure important communications and commitments stay organized and on schedule.

*Communications Support*

* Respond to routine inquiries and requests.
* Assist with communications to community members, volunteers, partners, and stakeholders.
* Prepare reminders, updates, and meeting communications.
* Support outreach and engagement efforts.

*Community \& Event Support*

* Assist with community events, workshops, meetings, and outreach activities.
* Help coordinate volunteer communications and event registrations.
* Support event logistics and participant engagement.
* Assist with surveys, sign\-ins, and community data collection activities.

*Operations Support*

* Support organizational systems and processes.
* Assist with project tracking and coordination.
* Help maintain organizational continuity and follow\-through.
* Support special projects and emerging organizational needs as assigned.

**Qualifications**

*Minimum Qualifications*

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Basic computer proficiency, including Microsoft Office, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, or similar tools.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through on assignments.
* Ability to work efficiently and independently.

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience in customer service, administration, nonprofit work, community engagement, events, education, public service, or related fields.
* Experience coordinating meetings, volunteers, events, community activities, or projects.
* Experience working with diverse communities.
* Bilingual skills are a plus but not required.

**Entry\-level and experienced candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.**

**Who We're Looking For**

We're less concerned about finding the "perfect" candidate and more interested in finding the right person.

The ideal candidate is:

* Reliable and dependable
* Honest and trustworthy
* Self\-motivated and proactive
* Organized and detail\-oriented
* Able to work efficiently and independently
* Comfortable taking initiative and solving problems
* Professional and respectful in communications
* Works well in collaborative team environments
* Willing to learn new skills and take on new responsibilities
* Able to adapt to changing priorities
* Passionate about community\-centered work

**We value integrity, accountability, communication, teamwork, and a willingness to learn just as much as prior experience.**

*If you don't meet every qualification listed but believe you would be a strong fit for this role, we encourage you to apply.*

**Local Candidates Strongly Encouraged to Apply**

jobs.title: Tour Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

The Tour Operations Coordinator will report directly to the Chief Operating Officer and play a key role in the planning and preparation of our events.

This position will be responsible for managing venue and hotel logistics from initial sourcing through final reconciliation. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable managing multiple events simultaneously, confident communicating with hotels and venues, and capable of maintaining accurate budgets, contracts, deadlines, and operational documentation.

Strong follow\-through, attention to detail, financial awareness, and the ability to proactively identify potential issues are essential for success in this role.

**Key ResponsibilitiesVenue Coordination**

* Research, identify, and evaluate potential venues for regional and national events based on event requirements, availability, location, capacity, and budget.
* Manage the venue sourcing and booking process, including inquiries, proposals, negotiations, contract review, date holds, and securing event dates.
* Maintain ongoing communication with venue contacts throughout the planning process to provide event details, schedules, Certificates of Insurance, and other required documentation.
* Request, collect, review, and organize necessary venue documentation, including but not limited to, floorplans, technical specifications, riser charts, power information, security policies, loading information, and venue guidelines.
* Coordinate venue\-related logistics including ballroom and exhibit hall holds, load\-in and load\-out requirements, AV regulations, labor requirements, union guidelines, security, cleaning, HVAC, power, and other operational needs.
* Work closely with the production team, logistics and event directors to gather venue information and assist in the creation and distribution of venue diagrams, info sheets, show documents, and other event materials.
* Maintain accurate venue budgets for each event, including projected costs, contracted costs, deposits, additional expenses, and final actual spend.
* Track projected versus actual event expenses throughout the planning cycle and maintain accurate, up\-to\-date event cost totals.
* Review venue invoices for accuracy, reconcile final charges against contracted rates and approved expenses, and identify billing discrepancies before payment.
* Track important contractual deadlines including deposits, payment schedules, cancellation dates, insurance requirements, and other venue obligations.
* Maintain organized records of venue contracts, proposals, invoices, floorplans, payment schedules, and supporting event documentation.

**Come join our amazing team and work Remote !**

Support assigned Account Executives(s) and TPO sales management. Responsible for assisting with tasks related to quality loan processing, reviewing files for adherence to underwriting standards and ensuring completeness of submission. Provide backup assistance for assigned Account Executive(s) in their absence, including assisting brokers and resolving issues. Support marketing efforts and work with brokers to facilitate timely loan closings. Perform all duties in accordance with the company’s policies and procedures, all US state and federal laws and regulations, wherein the company operates. The target pay range for this position is $25\.00 to $28\.00 / HR \+ Monthly Incentive plan.


**What you’ll do:**

* Perform all data input, data management, and other administrative tasks so that assigned Account Executive(s) can focus on sales activities including:
* Enter new contacts into the system o Input loan applications manually
* Schedule zoom sales calls with new brokers and existing clients
* Organize and input loan information received into the Loan Origination System o Gather loan applications, credit documents, appraisals, etc.
* Monitor incoming documents verifying data collected by Account Executives
* Pull or verify credit reports and flood certs as needed
* Send welcome mails to new accounts and loan officers
* Send thank you emails to brokers after closing
* Set up company approved LinkedIn marketing for daily posts
* Review all expiring locks to ensure extensions and review unlocked loans and send reminders to lock to brokers.
* Reach out to brokers regarding the month’s closings to push condition submittal and ensure account manager is aware of any updates or discovered items; note findings in conversation log.
* Proactively monitor pipeline to ensure timely funding of loans.
* Serve as point person on marketing projects, lead management assignments, and other projects intended to increase assigned Account Executive(s) sales, personal branding, and lead generation and conversion goals. Coordinate in person and online marketing events.
* In conjunction with sales management and assigned Account Executive(s), identify methods to expand assigned Account Executive(s) business model.
* Provide backup assistance for assigned Account Executive(s) in their absence, including assisting brokers and resolving issues.
* Ensure the quality and compliance Company policies, procedures, and investor guidelines.
* Prepare reports for Account Executive(s) and sales management.
* Develop individual relationships with assigned Account Executive(s) to determine any additional assistance that may be needed on a case by case basis.
* Complete various tasks and assignments and assist departmental support staff when requested by sales management.

**What you'll need:**

* Extremely high level of organizational skills and ability to work on several tasks simultaneously
* Proficient in the use of Carrington’s loan origination system and other systems used in the mortgage origination process, or if new to company the ability to learn systems quickly
* Highly proficient in the use of office machines such as computer, copiers, fax machines
* Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing
* Ability to handle detailed assignments and be self\-motivated
* Ability to organize and prioritize workload and meet deadlines
* Ability to maintain highly confidential information in accordance with Company’s privacy policy concerning borrower’s confidential information
* High School diploma or equivalent work experience.
* Two (2\) years’ mortgage industry experience required.
* Previous customer service, concierge, or customer experience required.
* Previous Retail Loan Processing or Wholesale Account Manager experience preferred.
* Experience working in a paperless environment preferred.

**Our Company:**

Carrington Mortgage Services\-Wholesale Lending is part of The Carrington Companies. We provide third\-party originators, mortgage brokers and financial institutions with access to government and conventional loan programs, as well as low credit score home financing and low down payment options. We hope you’ll consider joining our growing team of uniquely talented professionals as we transform residential real estate. To read more visit: www.carringtonwholesale.com .


**What is the value proposition to joining the team?**

* Increased earning capacity due to access to our 48 state territory.
* Ability to market faster and more efficiently inside the operation.
* Superior service levels offered to the broker as you’re inside presence ensures every step of the loan process is handled in the most efficient manner possible.
* Professional account manager’s partner with you and your brokers to add value every step of the way.
* Base pay plus an industry leading commission plan.
* Take over existing accounts.

**What We Offer:**

* Comprehensive healthcare plans for you and your family. Plus, a discretionary 401(k) match of 50% of the first 4% of pay contributed.
* Access to several fitness, restaurant, retail (and more!) discounts through our employee portal.
* Customized training programs to help you advance your career.
* Employee referral bonuses so you’ll get paid to help Carrington and Vylla grow.
* Educational Reimbursement.
* Carrington Charitable Foundation contributes to the community through causes that reflect the interests of Carrington Associates. For more information about Carrington Charitable Foundation, and the organizations and programs, it supports through specific fundraising efforts, please visit: carringtoncf.org.

**Notice to all applicants: Carrington does not do interviews or make offers via text or chat**

jobs.title: Junior Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Title: Junior Account Manager**


We are seeking a Junior Account Manager (JAM) supports Account Executives in the management, retention, and growth of commercial insurance accounts. This role independently services an assigned book of smaller business while developing advanced skills in client relationship management, coverage analysis, marketing, and renewal strategy. The JAM serves as a technical resource to the support team and is expected to progress toward full Account Manager responsibilities.

**Essential Functions \& Responsibilities**

* Independently service an assigned book of small commercial accounts
* Build and maintain client, carrier, and underwriter relationships
* Support renewal planning, retention efforts, and account growth initiatives
* Review policies, endorsements, and coverage recommendations for accuracy
* Process agency\-billed invoicing and related account transactions
* Respond to client requests and provide proactive service
* Assist clients with policy changes, endorsements, certificates, and coverage questions
* Support assigned larger accounts through marketing efforts, submissions, proposal preparation, and day\-to\-day servicing activities
* Prepare carrier submissions, supplemental applications, and new business documentation
* Assist with quote comparison, coverage analysis, and renewal preparations
* Support new business efforts through AMS account setup and online rating platforms
* Assist Account Managers and Account Executives with proposals, renewals, submissions, solicitations, and marketing efforts. Mentor and assist in the development of CSR I and CSR II team members
* Support the service team with complex account servicing activities and coverage\-related questions
* Assist with quality control efforts and promote adherence to department service standards
* Help balance team workload by assisting with priority, escalated, or time\-sensitive requests
* Occasional travel may be required, including an expectation of quarterly visits to the company headquarters in Calabasas, California.

**Required Skills \& Attributes**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities and capable of conveying information clearly and simply, to and from a wide variety of individuals.
* Demonstrates a strong commitment to client and customer satisfaction; ability to make independent decisions and use good judgment in addressing and servicing client needs.
* Able to follow direction, work independently, and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders; contributes to a positive and inclusive work environment.
* Possess strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; demonstrates sound judgment in addressing and resolving issues of moderate complexity with available resources.
* Ability to make independent decisions and use good judgment; works independently with general oversight and collaborates effectively as part of a team.
* Show a genuine willingness to learn, coupled with intuition, resourcefulness, and coachability; may provide informal guidance or support to peers.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment; exhibits strong organizational skills and capable of efficiently multitasking while reprioritizing work assignments based on business needs.
* High level of attention to detail essential; possess strong analytical skills with attention to detail and accuracy; consistently produces quality work with minimal errors.
* Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and the willingness to learn and use all computer programs as required.
* Maintain confidential information with the utmost discretion; consistently adheres to all applicable privacy, compliance, and regulatory requirements.

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
* Active Property \& Casualty (P\&C) insurance license required.
* Minimum of four (4\) years of commercial insurance experience.
* Progress toward a professional insurance designation.
* Strong understanding of commercial insurance coverages and account servicing.

**Work Schedule \& Environment**


This is a full\-time position, and hours of operation for the office are typically Monday through Friday, 8:30a.m. to 5:30p.m. Occasional overtime may be required.


Remote/Hybrid/In Office (dependent on location)

**Compensation**


Salary Range: $61,000\.00 \- $88,000\.00 per year dependent on experience

**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* FSA (traditional \& dependent care)
* Supplemental insurance options (STD, LTD, Life/AD\&D, LTC)
* 401(k) with Safe Harbor employer contribution
* PTO, floating holidays, sick leave, and paid holidays
* Paid leave programs (jury duty, parental, volunteer, disability)
* Employee Assistance Program \& discount programs
* Designation course reimbursement

**About Poms \& Associates:**


At Poms \& Associates, we redefine the insurance experience by offering innovative solutions for both business and personal insurance needs. With decades of experience and expertise, we are dedicated to helping clients stay protected and prepared. We believe that knowledge is the key to effective insurance and that proactive risk management is the smartest way to insure.


For more information about the company, please visit our website: https://www.pomsassoc.com/

jobs.title: Account Manager-Sales
jobs.description:
Description:

For more than 30 years, TriCore has partnered with leading food, beverage, and life science manufacturers to solve complex challenges through automation, engineering, and technology. Our team combines deep technical expertise with a practical, customer\-focused approach to deliver solutions that help clients operate more efficiently, safely, and intelligently.


At TriCore, you’ll join a team of problem\-solvers, innovators, and industry experts who work together to deliver meaningful results for our customers. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere, and we empower employees to take ownership, keep learning, embrace innovation, and make an impact.


If you’re looking for a place where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your work truly matters, we’d love to meet you.


The Account Manager owns growth and retention within assigned accounts through building strong relationships with existing and prospective customers, understanding each customer’s business needs, and taking a consultative approach to developing effective sales strategies. This role is responsible for developing and executing account plans, expanding customer engagement, identifying new opportunities, and partnering with internal teams to deliver solutions that create value for the customer and profitable growth for TriCore.


Success in this role is measured by account growth, customer retention, relationship quality, pipeline development, customer satisfaction, and conversion of opportunities into profitable business.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Build and maintain strong, consultative relationships with existing and prospective customers.
* Develop a deep understanding of each customer’s business, operational priorities, budgets, planning cycles, and growth opportunities.
* Create and execute account plans and sales strategies that strengthen relationships, expand engagement, and grow revenue.
* Identify, qualify, and advance sales opportunities within existing and prospective accounts.
* Lead customer discovery conversations to understand business challenges, priorities, timelines, and decision factors.
* Own the sales process for assigned opportunities, including follow\-up, next\-step planning, and driving opportunities to close.
* Engage internal technical and operational resources to support solution development, scoping, quoting, and customer recommendations.
* Apply an understanding of process systems, including mixing, batching, blending, CIP, and P\&IDs, to support solution development and proposal accuracy.
* Present TriCore’s capabilities and recommend solutions that align customer needs with TriCore’s value proposition.
* Maintain accurate customer, account, and opportunity information in Customer Center and other sales systems.
* Partner with internal teams to support a smooth handoff from sales to execution.
* Share customer insights, market trends, opportunity learnings, and best practices to strengthen sales effectiveness.

  

Requirements:
**Minimum Qualifications**

* 4\+ years of sales or account management experience, with a strong foundation in relationship\-based selling.
* Inside sales, outside sales, or account management experience in a technical or industrial business.
* Experience using a CRM tool to manage customer, account, and opportunity information.
* Ability to quickly learn new industries, business models, and customer environments.
* Strong consultative selling, discovery, listening, and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to develop account strategies and advance opportunities through a structured sales process.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate business value to stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, priorities, and follow\-up activities.
* Ability to travel to customer and prospective customer sites approximately 40% of the time, including visits to manufacturing, production, or industrial environments.
* Proactive, self\-directed, and comfortable working independently while contributing as part of a team.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Experience working with customers in manufacturing or industrial environments.
* Experience working with a process control integrator.
* Exposure to food, dairy, or beverage processing environments.
* Exposure to automation, controls, or industrial networking.
* Working knowledge of process systems such as mixing, batching, blending, CIP, and the ability to read and discuss P\&IDs is helpful but can be learned in the role.


There is a 2\-3 day in\-office requirement located in Orange, CA.

**Compensation \&Total Rewards**


Base Pay Range: $110,000 to $140,000 per year. TriCore offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, and retirement benefits, as well as opportunities for professional growth and development.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**


TriCore is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. TriCore provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees as required by applicable law.

**At\-Will Employment Statement**


Employment at TriCore is at\-will. This means that either the employee or the Company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause and with or without advance notice, subject to applicable law. Nothing in this job description, offer letter, or any other Company communication creates an employment contract, express or implied, or guarantees employment for any specific period of time. The at\-will nature of employment may only be modified by a written agreement signed by an authorized executive of the Company.

jobs.description:
**Supervision**



Reports to: Social Media Manager

  


**Come grow with us!**



Working at ViewSonic is a unique opportunity to do rewarding, meaningful, high\-visibility work for a global leader in visual technology. At ViewSonic, we are celebrating over 3 decades of excellence, carrying on the same entrepreneurial spirit and innovation we’ve had since 1987\. Our brand and products are well\-known throughout the industry. As a result, we are growing quickly and are looking for energetic, motivated team members to expand our nest.

  


**Your Role and Impact**



The Social Media Specialist plays a key role in growing ViewSonic’s social media presence through social\-first content development, publishing, community engagement, creator partnerships, real\-time marketing, and performance analysis. Working across corporate, commercial, education, and consumer initiatives, this role partners closely with the Social Media Manager, internal marketing teams, and regional and global stakeholders to translate campaigns, product stories, events, customer successes, and industry trends into compelling social content. The ideal candidate combines strong creative instincts with analytical thinking and understands how to develop content specifically for social audiences rather than simply adapting traditional marketing materials. This individual should be an excellent writer, a proactive collaborator, and someone who can move comfortably from content ideation to execution to performance recommendations. This role will have a particular emphasis on social content development and audience growth, while also supporting broader channel operations and community engagement as part of a collaborative social media team.

* Develop social\-first content concepts aligned with ViewSonic campaigns, products, customer stories, events, partnerships, and relevant cultural or industry moments.
* Write and develop compelling social copy, creative briefs, and content concepts for formats including static posts, carousels, short\-form video, interviews, product demonstrations, and event content.
* Support the Social Media Manager in executing the social editorial strategy and translating broader marketing priorities into platform\-appropriate content.

* Support creator and influencer marketing programs, including creator identification, outreach, campaign coordination, content review, activation, and performance reporting.
* Participate in live and real\-time social coverage of trade shows, events, product launches, customer activations, and other relevant moments.
* Monitor social conversations, audience sentiment, competitor activity, platform trends, and relevant industry discussions to identify content, engagement, and real\-time marketing opportunities.

* Partner with the Advertising team on paid\-social amplification, creative testing, campaign learnings, and opportunities to extend high\-performing organic content.
* Maintain organized publishing workflows, documentation, campaign assets, and editorial calendars in partnership with the broader social media team.
* Collaborate with regional and global marketing teams to adapt campaigns and content for social audiences while maintaining consistency with ViewSonic’s brand and strategic priorities.
* Attend periodic evening meetings with ViewSonic’s global marketing team in Taipei as business needs require.

jobs.title: Area Sales Representative, Neurovascular - Los Angeles, CA
jobs.description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on \- 18 Sep 2026  

  

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.


**A Day in the Life**
=====================

Across our global Neuroscience organization, we advance care for some of medicine’s most complex neurological and spinal conditions. By combining innovative technology, data\-driven insights, and deep clinical expertise, we partner with physicians and health systems to improve how patients are treated and supported throughout their care journey.  

Our Neurovascular operating unit advances treatment of stroke, brain aneurysms, and vascular disorders through innovative endovascular technologies. With devices designed for revascularization, embolization, and precise intervention, we support clinicians in delivering timely, effective care for complex neurovascular conditions.


Check us out on LinkedIn: Medtronic Neurovascular


Our mission is to save lives. Scientia Vascular is a leading innovator and manufacturer of endovascular medical devices. We use micromachining and microfabrication processes to manufacture products that provide physicians with enhanced performance for optimal outcomes for their patients.


**Scientia is now part of Medtronic.**

The Area Sales Representative (ASR) serves within the Sales organization reporting directly to their assigned Area Sales Manager. The ASR is responsible for sales and customer support in their assigned territory. In the performance of their duties, the ASR will be responsible for meeting assigned territory sales objectives, developing relationships with physician customers and hospital personnel, and supporting the region as needed to ensure growth goals are achieved.


**This is a field\-based position in Los Angeles and covering the surrounding area. 75% travel is expected for this role.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Works closely with the Area Sales Manager to identify and evaluate market opportunities, sales potential by account, and establish and achieve annual sales objectives
* Develops and implements sales strategies and tactics by determining the relevant factors (e.g., products, competition, and pricing needs) of existing and potential accounts to effectively promote Scientia’s products
* Completes a thorough analysis of the territory and identifies key target accounts, while monitoring competitive activities by gathering current marketplace information
* Collaborates with the Area Sales Manager on contracts, pricing, and vendor documentation requirements for hospital and institutional customers
* Implements and executes the launch strategies developed by the Vice President of Sales while providing product introductions and in\-services for customers
* Maintains clinical and technical expertise through company training sessions, on\-the\-job training, educational workshops, professional publications, personal networks, and professional societies. Takes the initiative to expand clinical, technical, and business knowledge
* Prepares and submits reports to sales management by analyzing territory sales and customer data as well as sales projections. Can effectively communicate to all levels within the hospital and Scientia Leadership
* Complies with all company, hospital/institution, and Advised guidelines for compliance and professional conduct. Understands the business environment and relates experience and knowledge, while exercising independent judgment and decision\-making

**Required Qualifications:** 

* Bachelors degree and minimum of 2 years of relevant experience, or advanced degree with 0 years of experience
* Proficiency using CRM tools
* Valid driver's license and active vehicle insurance policy

**Preferred Qualifications:**

jobs.title: Social Media & Digital Communications Specialist
jobs.description:
**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**



Rocket Lab is the end\-to\-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**SOCIAL MEDIA \& DIGITAL COMMUNICATIONS SPECIALIST**

The Rocket Lab communications team translates literal rocket science into impactful and compelling stories that captivate the globe. We are looking for a Social Media \& Digital Communications Specialist who lives and breathes digital storytelling, thrives in high\-stakes environments, and wants to run one of the most exciting feeds in space. This is not a cruise\-control 9\-to\-5\. Rockets launch at 3:00 AM, mission milestones happen in real\-time across multiple time zones, and the unexpected is around every corner. If you want a comfortable corporate routine, this isn't it. If you want to shape the voice of a company shaping humanity's future in space, read on.


**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:**

* **Build the Content Engine:** Plan, maintain, and execute an aggressive digital editorial calendar aligned with missions, program milestones, and strategic company goals.
* **Own the Channels**: Lead day\-to\-day execution across X, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Bluesky, subscriber newsletters and emerging platforms.
* **Understand the Audience:** Tailor content to our broad range of audiences spanning B2B and B2G, talent candidates, investors, and fans.
* **Cover the Action in Real Time:** Work with our media content producers to capture, package, and publish live coverage for launches, hot fires, spacecraft deployments, trade shows, and major company milestones.
* **Translate Rocket Science**: Partner directly with engineers, mission operators, and production teams to turn complex technical achievements into sharp, accessible content.
* **Drive Growth with Data:** Monitor platform analytics, spot trends before they fade, experiment with AI tools and new formats, and ruthlessly optimize for reach and engagement.
* **Guard the Brand Voice:** Ensure every caption, clip, graphic, and post matches Rocket Lab's standard of quality, technical accuracy, and unmistakable tone.
* **Expand the Frontier:** Challenge the status quo of how aerospace communicates. Bring fresh tech, unconventional distribution strategies, and bold creative experiments that keep us leagues ahead of the industry.
* **Roll Your Sleeves Up:** This isn't a pure strategy role insulated from the execution. You are on the tools every single day, drafting, shooting, editing, and driving projects from concept to feed. You can expect to live tweet countdowns, get out onto the factory floor to get the story, write the post, and hit publish yourself.


**YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 5\+ years of experience. Proven track record running high\-growth, high\-engagement social channels and digital campaigns for a fast\-moving brand.
* A sharp portfolio with direct proof of killer campaigns you built and executed personally.
* Experience in both organic and paid social campaigns and strategies. Deep understanding of how to roll out effective paid social and digital campaigns to serve specific business needs.
* Flexibility to travel and move fast: Ready to support on\-site activations, events, and dynamic launch schedules across time zones.


 **THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:**

* Bachelors degree.
* Ability to distil complex ideas into short, witty, punchy copy with zero fluff and flawless attention to detail.
* Extreme ownership. You don't wait for a brief. You spot what needs doing, hunt for an answer, pick up a camera, or open a draft, and get it done.
* Calm, decisive judgment when breaking news hits or launch countdowns are ticking live.
* Experience in aerospace, defence, motorsport or tech industries.
* An authentic obsession with space exploration and technology.
* You don't have to be able to have hands on photo/video capture and mobile editing skills but it would be beneficial.
* Experience in a start\-up environment


*This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.*

**WHAT TO EXPECT**



We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out\-think, out\-work, and out\-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.



Important information:


**FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:**


*To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR* *here**.*

jobs.title: LA Galaxy, Digital Marketing Analyst
jobs.description:
**Company Information**  

For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300\+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.  

  

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.  

  

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!


**Job Summary**

  


The Digital Marketing Analyst is responsible for developing and managing the organization's marketing reporting, dashboarding, audience insights, and business intelligence capabilities. This role will support data\-driven decision making across marketing, ticketing, partnerships, ecommerce, and fan engagement initiatives through actionable reporting and performance analysis. This position will oversee marketing dashboards, tracking implementation, audience analysis, and campaign reporting for paid media while helping establish scalable measurement frameworks and insight generation processes. The role will work closely with stakeholders across departments to identify trends, uncover opportunities, and inform strategic decision making.  


**Essential Functions**
* Develop, update, and maintain marketing and business performance dashboards and recurring reports that provide visibility into KPIs, marketing channel performance, campaign effectiveness, and revenue outcomes. Coordinate with Data Analyst on ticketing and business reporting and analysis.
* Partner with internal and external teams to set up, establish and manage tracking infrastructure, tagging standards, and attribution frameworks across digital channels and platforms, including website, ecommerce, and paid campaigns and channels in coordination with Paid Media Manager.
* Analyze fan, customer, and campaign data to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable business insights that support organizational objectives.
* Support audience segmentation and reporting frameworks that support lifecycle marketing, personalization, paid media optimization, and fan engagement strategies
* Deliver reporting and insights to stakeholders across marketing, ticketing, partnerships, and other business functions.
* Assist the development of forecasting, pacing, and performance measurement models tied to acquisition, retention, and monetization goals.
* Collaborate with digital product and marketing teams to measure conversion performance, funnel behavior, and user experience optimization initiatives.
* Ensure data integrity, reporting consistency, and measurement accuracy across dashboards, analytics platforms, and business reporting tools.
* Establish and maintain standardized reporting processes, documentation, and business review cadences across departments.
* Stay informed on emerging analytics tools, dashboarding capabilities, and measurement best practices to improve organizational reporting maturity.


**Required Qualifications**


* BA/BS Degree (4\-year) (Advanced Degree Preferred) Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, Analytics, Product or related technical field.
* 2\-4 years Related work experience.
* Experience creating dashboards, reports, and marketing performance analyses that support business decision making.
* Experience working with digital analytics and campaign measurement tools, including tracking and reporting processes.
* Strong experience translating complex data and analytics into actionable business insights, including audience segmentation, lifecycle analysis, performance measurement, and fan engagement strategies that drive revenue outcomes.
* Experience identifying business opportunities, structuring analyses, synthesizing findings, and delivering clear, data\-driven recommendations to cross\-functional stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Experience partnering cross\-functionally with marketing, ticketing, partnerships, digital product, and operations teams to align analytics initiatives with commercial and organizational objectives.
* Experience supporting conversion optimization, campaign performance analysis, and customer journey insights across acquisition, retention, upsell, and engagement initiatives.
* Familiarity with analytics, visualization, and marketing technology platforms such as GA4, Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI, CRM/CDP platforms, and digital advertising platforms preferred.
* Experience in sports, media, entertainment, or consumer\-facing digital businesses preferred but not required.
* Must be flexible to respond quickly and positively to shifting demands and opportunities; able to work under tight deadlines and handle multiple, detailed tasks.
* Strong attention to detail, effective follow\-up and follow through required.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present data insights and reporting findings to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of data privacy, governance, and security principles, with experience handling sensitive and confidential data.
* Experience working with analytics and marketing technology platforms including GA4, Tableau, Looker Studio, Power BI, CRM/CDP platforms, and dashboarding tools.
* Familiarity with tracking, attribution modeling, campaign measurement, and customer journey analytics across digital ecosystems.

**Independent Veterinary Sales Representative – Los Angeles / Southern California**  
**1099 Independent Contractor \| Commission\-Based \| Territory Opportunity**

Alexander International Innovations, LLC is expanding its veterinary sales presence in Southern California and is seeking experienced, relationship\-driven independent sales representatives.

Southern California has one of the largest and most active veterinary markets in the country. We are looking for motivated professionals who understand their local market and are ready to develop a protected territory with significant growth potential.

**About the Opportunity**

You will introduce veterinary hospitals, specialty and emergency practices, general practices, and other animal\-health organizations to I2F®, a patented medical device designed to support more efficient medication preparation, improve vial access, and reduce avoidable medication waste.

This is an independent contractor opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, educating clinical teams, and developing a territory over time. It is especially well suited for an established veterinary, medical, pharmaceutical, or healthcare sales professional who wants to add an innovative product to their portfolio.

This position begins with a focus on veterinary medicine. As AII expands into the human healthcare market following the necessary regulatory clearance, established representatives will have the opportunity to grow with the company and represent I2F within eligible human healthcare accounts.

**Responsibilities**

* Identify and develop prospective veterinary accounts within an assigned Los Angeles/Southern California territory
* Conduct in\-person visits with veterinary hospitals and clinical teams
* Present and demonstrate I2F to veterinarians, veterinary technicians, practice managers, pharmacy personnel, and purchasing decision\-makers
* Develop long\-term relationships with prospective and existing customers
* Follow up on product evaluations, questions, and purchasing opportunities
* Maintain accurate records of contacts, visits, and sales activity in the company CRM
* Represent Alexander International Innovations professionally at local conferences, meetings, and networking events when appropriate
* Collaborate with company leadership and other representatives to support market development

**Who We’re Looking For**

* Previous veterinary, medical device, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or business\-to\-business sales experience preferred
* Existing relationships within the veterinary community are strongly preferred
* Comfortable entering veterinary facilities, initiating conversations, and conducting product demonstrations
* Self\-directed, dependable, and able to manage a territory independently
* Strong communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills
* Consistent follow\-through and willingness to remain engaged throughout the sales process
* Comfortable using email, video meetings, and a web\-based CRM
* Located in the Los Angeles/Southern California area and able to travel locally within the assigned territory
* Access to reliable transportation

**Compensation**

* 1099 independent contractor position
* Commission\-based compensation with uncapped earning potential
* Increased commission opportunity based on sales performance
* No income ceiling
* Territory growth and recurring customer orders can create meaningful long\-term earning potential

**What We Provide**

* A patented, clinically relevant product with applications across veterinary medicine
* Product education, onboarding, and ongoing sales support
* Demonstration materials and professionally developed marketing resources
* Access to company leadership and clinical experts
* CRM access and territory\-development support
* Opportunities to grow alongside an emerging healthcare innovation company
* Protected territory consideration based on performance and continued activity
* Early\-entry opportunity with a growing healthcare innovation company
* Representatives who successfully establish and maintain their veterinary territories will have the opportunity to expand into the human healthcare market following the necessary regulatory clearance and commercial launch
* Future potential to work with hospitals, infusion centers, specialty pharmacies, home infusion providers, and other human healthcare organizations

**About Alexander International Innovations**

Alexander International Innovations, LLC develops innovative solutions for human and veterinary medicine. Our work is driven by clinical experience and a commitment to improving medication preparation, reducing preventable waste, and supporting the responsible stewardship of healthcare resources.

We are building a nationwide network of professionals who believe meaningful healthcare innovation begins by understanding the challenges clinicians face every day.

This position is best suited for someone who wants to actively build a territory.

Please submit your résumé along with a brief description of:

* Your veterinary, medical, pharmaceutical, or healthcare sales experience
* The Southern California region you currently cover or would like to represent
* Any existing relationships you have within the veterinary community
* Why this independent, commission\-based opportunity interests you

Alexander International Innovations, LLC provides equal opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Job Types: Full\-time, Part\-time, Contract

Benefits:

**Materials Sales Representative**

Precast Concrete Products — Outbound Business Development

**Location:** Pomona, CA (serving Southern \+ Northern California)

**Job type:** Full\-Time

**Pay:** $70,000–$95,000 base salary \+ uncapped commission on the margin you produce

We manufacture precast concrete fence and wall systems at our own plants in Pomona and Hollister — and this role owns selling that product as materials: to contractors, fence dealers, GCs, public agencies, and the architects and engineers who write us into their specs. You'll inherit an active book of business and a standing quote pipeline from day one. This is not a cold\-start territory.

**Who We Are**

American Precast Concrete is a vertically integrated manufacturer of precast concrete fence and wall systems, with our own installation division (Concrete Fence Installers). The materials lane you'll own is a standalone revenue engine: customers who buy our panels, posts, and wall systems and install themselves. We control production, which means you can sell with real answers on lead times, custom work, and delivery.

**What You'll Own**

* **The quote engine:** every qualified materials inquiry gets an accurate, complete quote inside our SLA — correct product, quantities, delivery logistics, and terms, with assumptions documented.
* **Pipeline follow\-through:** disciplined follow\-up on every open quote. Nothing ages out because nobody called back.
* **Outbound growth:** build and work a target list of contractors, dealers, GCs, and agencies. Net\-new accounts are a core measure of this seat, not a side activity.
* **A\&E specification selling:** work with architects and engineers to get our products specified on projects — the long game that fills next year's pipeline.
* **The relationship:** own APC material customer relationships end to end, including warranty and service cases through documented resolution.
* **Clean systems:** complete HubSpot records — every deal has a stage, a next step, and a date.

**What We're Looking For**

**Required**

* 3\+ years selling construction materials or building products (precast, masonry, aggregates, fencing, lumber, or adjacent) with a track record you can talk through in numbers.
* Can read site plans well enough to take off linear footage, heights, and product types for a quote.
* Disciplined CRM habits — you document because it wins deals, not because someone makes you.
* Valid CA driver's license; comfortable with regular customer and site visits.

**Preferred**

* Precast concrete or concrete masonry product knowledge.
* Existing relationships with SoCal or NorCal contractors, fence dealers, or public agencies.
* Experience selling to or through architects/engineers (specification selling).
* Bilingual English/Spanish.
* HubSpot experience.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* $70,000–$95,000 base salary \+ uncapped commission on the margin you produce—final structure discussed at offer.
* Company vehicle or allowance for customer and site visits; phone allowance.
* Paid holidays and PTO.
* An active book of business and live quote pipeline from day one.

**How to Apply**

Reply with your resume and 2–3 sentences on the largest materials account or order you personally landed—what you sold, roughly what it was worth, and how you won it. We move fast: phone screen within days, structured interview and a live work sample at our Pomona plant, and decision within the week.

Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $95,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**Company Description**  

We take care of our employees, and they take care of our customers!


Become a member of a global community! The international logistics industry is an integral piece of the global trade puzzle; we make the world go round. Global supply chain management is what we do, and at the heart of Expeditors you will find professionalism, leadership, and a friendly environment, all of which foster an innovative, customer service\-based approach to logistics. Expeditors is a global logistics company headquartered in Seattle, Washington. As a Fortune 500 company, we employ over 19,000 trained professionals in a worldwide network of over 350\+ locations across six continents. Expeditors satisfies the increasingly sophisticated needs of international trade through customized solutions and seamless, integrated information systems.


Our Mission


We recruit, train, and retain the very best logistics and technical experts the world over. **We love to promote from within** \- more than 50 percent of our employees have been at Expeditors for five years or more. Our high retention rate is influenced by a unique compensation program for positions that are more than just jobs \- they're chances to grow, do what you love and build a career with us!

 **Job Description** **Scope of Position:**

* Responsible for providing excellent customer service and the timely movement of air cargo for the West region that is in accordance with the company mission statement and in compliance with all applicable regulations.
* A summary of the process would be receiving cargo (if from another origin), booking the cargo, processing consolidation paperwork, and scanning all documents into our document imaging system.
* Dispatching and overseeing all airport transfers and pickups with local trucking vendors.

**Position Schedule:** Tuesday \- Saturday, 08:00\-16:30

  

**Major Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Provide excellent customer service – both internal/external whether verbal or email
* Effective interpersonal skills \- ability to relate to internal peers at different levels as well as external customers and vendors.
* Ability to work without constant supervision \- self motivation and attention to detail required.
* Maintaining positive relationships : immediate counterparts in the air export departments in the region, airlines, truckers, ground handlers, etc.
* Maintains constant communication with warehouse staff during consolidation to ensure shipment quality and compliance
* Responsible for daily updating and monitoring of various reporting tools and rates from vendors
* Detailed attention to accounting to ensure we are paying our bills timely and correctly.
* Responsible for the management of our capacity through posted consolidation schedules and in booking additional space as needed.
* Complete required training associated with specialized cargo: dangerous goods, temp control, LATAM for all types of cargo being handled
* Constant self\-development.

 **Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications:**

As the Specialist Manager, Business Development Representative within the Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice, you will support our growing services practice **.** The Practice delivers focused Agentic Services with the client's chosen OpenAI technologies, bringing industry depth and technical rigor to every phase of their AI journey including ChatGPT Enterprise, domain\-based customer models, agentic workflows and frontier platforms as well as change management and cybersecurity.  

  

Business Development Representatives are members of a dynamic, co\-evolving community of individuals working together with Deloitte's Sales and Growth Platform organizations to create and capture value and position Deloitte's capabilities and expertise in the market across various technology platforms.  

  

This is a Deloitte business\-development role focused on identifying and shaping opportunities for permissible Deloitte professional services. It is not an OpenAI product\-sales, reseller, referral, channel, or joint\-selling role. The role operates through Deloitte account and pursuit teams and is independent from the operations from OpenAI.  

  

Deloitte can advise and implement OpenAI products and interact with OpenAI in a manner that adheres to the independence guardrails, consistent with the rules and policies of the Securities Exchange Commission.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 9/30/2026\.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a Specialist Manager, Business Development Representative for the Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice team, you will be responsible for:
  

* **Identifying top\-of\-funnel opportunities:** Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders across Deloitte account teams and the Practice. Participate in internal only account planning activities by identifying relevant opportunities while ensuring adherence with independence guidelines.
* **Building awareness of the practice:** Creating market and internal awareness of the Practice to source new leads and opportunities. Additionally, generate awareness and educate Deloitte practitioners on Deloitte's services capabilities while ensuring we are adhering to Independence Guidelines.
* **Support client relevant deliverables:** Assist Deloitte's go\-to\-market team in creating new industry or domain specific, success stories, quals and proposal submissions, focusing on Deloitte professional services. Initiate the development and execution of lead generation field events, collateral, case studies, videos, or white papers. Coordinate with account teams for follow\-ups and drive deal progression.
* **Partner across sales teams:** Engage with Deloitte internal sales teams to explore opportunities for cross\-sell/upsell across technologies, platforms, offerings (e.g. AI\&E, Human Capital, Customer etc.) and domains (Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain, HR etc.). Demonstrate comprehensive Industry sales coverage by generating new leads for sales executives.

  

**The successful candidate would possess these skills:**  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

  

**The Team**  

  

This role sits within the Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice, under the Technology Relationships segment of Deloitte's Growth Platforms organization.  

  

Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice is geared around advising, implementing, and operating solutions for our clients who have selected OpenAI's GenAI models (e.g. Enterprise, Codex, etc.). Required:

* Fluency in Cloud Analytics/Data Platforms and Agentic/AI technologies.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

* Experience executing sales and capturing strategies and initiatives to transition underperforming IT organizations and programs to become customer\-centric and operate a service delivery model.

===================

**1\. Position Overview**


The Mobile Business Unit supports the global distribution of mobile devices with a focus on speed, reliability, and operational efficiency. The Logistics Coordinator (Air \& Ocean Operations) is responsible for planning, executing, and continuously improving inbound and outbound air and ocean freight operations, ensuring shipments move efficiently from manufacturers to Samsung warehouses and ultimately to customers.


This position requires hands\-on experience in Air or Ocean Freight Operations, along with solid ocean freight knowledge. * Analytical Thinking: Translate large data sets into actionable insights.

* Proven experience managing transload warehouse operations and Truckload (TL) dispatch.

Technical Account Manager

BAY AREA · NORTHERN CALIFORNIA FULL\-TIME BASE \+ MILESTONE BONUSES \+ UNCAPPED COMMISSION

01\. ABOUT US

Trilion Quality Systems is a precision metrology and NDE company based in King of Prussia, PA, and the US representative for ZEISS IQS optical testing systems. Our sister company, Xi Analytics, develops real\-time optical metrology and AI\-based measurement technology for advanced material testing and aerospace structural applications.

As the exclusive ZEISS Certified Metrology Partner in North America, Trilion’s experienced team of thirty people has spent the last 30 years doing one thing: connecting physical measurement with certified digital insight. More than 90% of the top ten US aerospace, automotive, biomechanics, and electronics companies work with us as their ZEISS DIC partner. This means that you will spend most weeks on innovative projects at Fortune 100 aerospace, defense, automotive, and consumer electronics companies, on test articles that are usually confidential, and you will be the person they call first. We’re an agile team and you won’t waste months waiting on committees and layers of management.

02\. ABOUT THE ROLE

Trilion is opening a Bay Area office around San Mateo in 2026 and hiring a Technical Account Manager to carry Northern California. This is a quota\-carrying, field\-based role, and you will be the primary technical and commercial contact for customers in the territory from the first conversation through demonstration, proposal, purchase order, and long\-term account growth.

You will spend most of your week in front of engineers in their test labs, not behind a desk. Optical metrology is sold by showing it, so much of the job is setting up a system on a customer's test article and letting the data make the argument. Strain gauges read a handful of points and miss the concentrations and asymmetries that decide whether a design passes certification. Full\-field DIC makes every pixel a measurement point, in 3D, NIST\-traceable, and ready for FEA correlation in minutes.

You will not be just a coordinator who forwards technical questions. Once ramped, you are expected to be able to run standard demonstrations and beginner trainings yourself, with our expert engineering team behind you for complex projects, dedicated multi\-day training, and on\-site service work. The technical credibility that comes with it is how you sell on results and direct knowledge rather than on a brochure.

You will not be working a blank list. Leads reach you through ZEISS and through Trilion’s own marketing, and you will generate the rest yourself at proven trade shows, through customer referrals, and by developing accounts we already serve. Revenue splits close to evenly three ways: new accounts, new teams inside existing accounts, and recurring business from our customer base. This means that a majority of projects will come from customers who already know and trust us, which is why account management matters here as much as new business. The ramp is deliberate: expect full autonomy over the territory within 6 to 8 months, backed by milestone bonuses while the funnel builds. Your first three months will follow a structured onboarding plan with active coaching, defined milestones and hands\-on time alongside our engineers, so you are not left to work it out on your own. Capital equipment cycles are long, but we don’t starve a good engineer waiting for the first sale to close.

03\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Territory and accounts

* Own the Bay Area and Northern California territory across aerospace, microelectronics and consumer electronics, space and defense, automotive and EV, medical device, and industrial and civil structures
* Work inbound leads from ZEISS and our digital marketing through qualification to first meeting
* Generate the rest of your pipeline yourself: trade show and conference follow\-up, referrals, and prospecting into new groups inside accounts we already serve
* Support existing accounts and identify follow\-on system, software, and service opportunities
* Forecast territory opportunities accurately and keep management updated on a regular cadence

Technical selling and delivery

* Present and demonstrate ARAMIS, ATOS, TRITOP, and the wider ZEISS portfolio at customer test labs and trade shows
* Run standard demonstrations and basic software training independently once ramped, including specimen preparation and system setup
* Process and present measurement results, and run proof\-of\-concept engagements and ROI analyses tied to the customer's test program
* Bring in our engineering team for complex projects, multi\-day training, and service work

Deal execution

* Design and develop tailored proposals and system configurations
* Manage the full sales process from first contact through purchase order
* Maintain accurate account, contact, and opportunity records in HubSpot CRM and Odoo ERP

04\. ABOUT YOU

* 2 to 3 years of experience in technical sales, applications engineering, or hands\-on test and measurement work, in aerospace \& defense, electronics \& AR/VR hardware, automotive \& EV, robotics, biomechanics, material science or an adjacent field
* MS/BS in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering, Material Science or similar Engineering Major
* Comfortable with mechanical engineering fundamentals: strain, stress, fatigue, and structural test
* Comfortable explaining technical concepts clearly and concisely to test engineers and executives
* Hands\-on experience with test equipment or measurement instrumentation, and the confidence to run a live system demonstration in front of a customer without support
* Willing and able to generate your own pipeline: outbound calls and emails, trade show and conference follow\-up, and prospecting into adjacent groups at existing accounts
* Organized and self\-directed; this territory runs on a plan you build yourself
* Excellent computer skills including AI usage for day\-to\-day sales engineerin
