jobs.description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**


When you are part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll do challenging work and be part of a team that values performance, quality and innovation. As part of a successful, growing global organization, you will be encouraged to perform at your best. With revenues of $40 billion and the largest investment in R\&D in the industry, we give our people the resources and opportunities to make significant contributions to the world.

**Location:** East Coast US\- Remote


As a **Business Development Executive** within our Pharma Services Biotech Account Management team, you will support the development and execution of territory and account plans to drive sales growth within your assigned accounts and prospect opportunities within your assigned territory across our broad range of drug modalities, which may include Steriles, Solid Dosage, Biologics, Cell Therapy, Viral Vector, and API.


In the role you will be responsible for implementing business strategies, annual marketing \& business plans, forecasting, providing marketing/competitive feedback and customer satisfaction relative to sales activities and profitable growth.


To be successful in the role you will need strong scientific and commercial acumen, be target\-focussed, and excel at building trusted relationships and demonstrating deep customer insight. You will also need strong customer relationship, communication and consultative selling skills, with the ability to identify opportunities and support customer success, data\-driven decision\-making, and resilience, alongside exceptional communication and the ability to work well in complex and competitive environments.

**A Day in the Life**

**Sales \& Business Development**

* Drive profitable growth and achieve/exceed AOP targets
* Secure new molecules, service expansions and increase share of wallet for existing biotech accounts
* Consultative selling through the full sales cycle from outreach to negotiation and contract execution
* Support the development and closure of commercial opportunities, quotations and contracts
* Identify and pursue opportunities within assigned accounts and prospects
* Create demand by aligning solutions to customer needs and pain points

**Territory \& Pipeline Management**

* Execute territory sales plans and contribute to territory growth objectives
* Build and maintain a strong, actionable pipeline
* Identify and maximise opportunities within existing accounts
* Maintain accurate forecasting and SFDC discipline

**Customer \& Market Leadership**

* Build and maintain effective relationships with customer stakeholders across assigned accounts
* Understand customer structures, decision\-makers, and industry trends
* Communicate Thermo Fisher’s value as an integrated solutions partner
* Monitor competitive activity and adapt strategies to mitigate threats

**Collaboration \& Customer Experience**

* Have a global mindset and partner cross\-functionally (SMEs, operations, finance, legal) to deliver solutions
* Participate in customer meetings, events, and site visits to support business development activities
* Champion customer experience proactively with urgency, integrity, and accountability
* Provide feedback to improve customer experience and internal processes
* Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders to support customer needs and sales objectives

**Key Requirements**

* 3\-5 years of quota\-carrying field sales or business development experience
* Previous sales, deal design and relationship management experience essential
* Experience of sales within a CDMO, and in one or more of our current drug modalities (Steriles, Solid Dosage, Biologics, Cell Therapy, Viral Vector, and API) will be a distinct advantage
* Strong analytical skills including financial competence
* Strong relationship\-building skills with customers and internal stakeholders
* Experience managing sales opportunities and customer relationships within a matrix environment
* Experience progressing opportunities through a consultative sales process
* Strong commercial acumen with experience shaping solutions and influencing deal outcomes
* Confident communicator with executive presence and strong negotiation skills
* Highly competitive, self\-directed, and results\-driven mindset
* Comfortable operating with urgency, ambiguity, and limited structure
* Willingness to travel up to 50 percent to meet customers and showcase Thermo Fisher sites

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in a Life Sciences field required

**Why This Role Is Distinct**


Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.


As one team of 100,000\+ colleagues, we share a common set of values — Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement — working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.


\#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.


Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com

**Compensation and Benefits**


The salary range estimated for this position based in Massachusetts is $102,200\.00–$153,350\.00\.
This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes:

* A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs
* Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement
* At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short\- and long\-term disability in

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role**


We're expanding our Customer Success team and seeking an exceptional Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our growing organization and elevate our customer experience. As a CSM at Silna, you’ll work to drive retention, expansion and customer satisfaction while managing our most valuable enterprise relationships. If you're energized by creating impactful processes and have a talent for building lasting customer partnerships, this role is designed for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Enterprise Management:** You'll be the primary advocate for our enterprise accounts, guiding them from onboarding through their entire customer journey with us. This role combines strategic thinking, problem\-solving, and relationship building.
* **Establish trust and credibility:** Healthcare is built on trust, and you'll be responsible for establishing authentic relationships with our partners.
* **Product Expert:** When customers need insights about Silna's platform, your comprehensive product knowledge will help them maximize value from our solutions.
* **Sales\-forward mindset:** Silna’s existing customer base has myriad routes for expansion. Identifying and executing on expansion opportunities is a core competency for this role.
* **Analytics Specialist:** You'll leverage your analytical mindset to monitor account health and identify trends that drive customer success.
* **Systems Thinker:** You take ownership of our operations, examining processes from end\-to\-end to identify strategic improvements that drive sustainable organizational change.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 3\-5 years of experience in Customer Success experience in a high\-growth SaaS company
* 2\+ years managing Enterprise Customers (six figure contracts)
* Proven track record of managing and growing enterprise relationships
* Strong project management skills with experience handling multiple concurrent high\-priority initiatives
* Excellent communication skills \- spiking on the ability to *build relationships* \- with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Ability to work from the Silna office in Manhattan 5 days/week.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Healthcare technology industry experience
* Experience with complex technical workflows
* Demonstrated success in driving account expansion and upsell opportunities

**The Ideal Candidate Will Demonstrate**

* Natural relationship\-building abilities and excellent interpersonal skills
* Ability to thrive in ambiguous situations and create structure where none exists
* Strong initiative and self\-motivation to identify and pursue opportunities independently
* Ability to quickly establish rapport with anyone in a new environment
* Strategic thinking with a focus on driving business outcomes
* Exceptional organizational and multitasking capabilities

**What Sets You Apart**

* You relish the opportunity to take on a new challenge
* You persevere and never give up no matter the situation or likelihood of failure
* You understand what motivates different stakeholders in an organization and quickly identify corporate political paradigms
* You enjoy getting to know strangers and can quickly adapt to any personality type.

**About Silna**
---------------


Healthcare is obsessed with optimizing a broken system. We're making sure it never breaks.


Silna Health attacks the root cause of denied claims: the fragmented, incompatible systems that govern prior authorizations, eligibility verification, and benefit checks, turning workflows that used to take days into decisions made in minutes, before care is ever delivered.


We work across behavioral health, physical health, ambulatory care, and post\-acute care, where administrative failure doesn't just cost money; it can delay or deny patient access entirely. We're backed by Accel and Bain Capital Ventures, and we're building fast.

**What We Offer**

* A rapid\-paced work environment with an incredibly enthusiastic and motivated team.
* The opportunity to work with customers that ***actually love*** the product.
* The ability to work on a technology that is materially improving health outcomes
* Competitive compensation and benefits package
* 401k
* Unlimited PTO


Compensation Range: $130K \- $185K

jobs.title: Customer Success Associate
jobs.description:
Runwise is looking for an entry\-level **Customer Success Associate** who is highly motivated, results\-oriented, and looking to learn about Customer Success and the SaaS/PropTech industry.



Runwise (www.runwise.com) is a fast\-paced, customer\-focused New York City / Boston based energy tech startup that controls and runs the heating systems in nearly 8000 buildings throughout the United States. Runwise's unique hardware and software service significantly reduces energy usage, substantially lowering costs and carbon output. The average reduction in energy use across those buildings was 21%. Together, those buildings saved more than $44 million in energy costs to date.



As a Customer Success Associate at Runwise you will have the opportunity to work directly with our Customer Success Managers. Each customer and each building has unique needs. You will assist our Customer Success Managers, helping them effectively manage their books of business while you learn our product and services. You will be an integral part of our customer experience, helping our customers run their heating systems in an energy efficient way that makes tenants more comfortable.


**Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:**


* Assisting property managers, supers, and owners with the Runwise platform
* Drafting and delivering savings reports for existing customers
* Pulling reports and reviewing customer data to distill trends, flag inconsistencies, etc.
* Reviewing customer dashboards, usage, etc. to help identify trends and triggers to escalate to Customer Success Managers
* Proactively identifying potential problems that may lead to reduced savings or a miss on customer goals
* Assisting Customer Success Managers in building relationships with all parties interested in the Runwise product (supers, property managers, owners)
* Managing internal CRM tools, maintaining customer data hygiene, and executing playbooks
* Engaging with clients directly and facilitating ongoing adoption of product and platform utilization
* Working cross\-functionally to maintain customer records, signals, and data


**Who you are:**


* You have 0\-1 years of direct customer management experience in a Customer Success, Support or Account Management role or are interested in learning about the Customer Success space

jobs.description:
**SALARY:** $68,000 \- $75,000

*Placement within the range for this position is based on a number of factors, including but not limited to, years of experience, relevant qualifications, skills, local market and budgetary considerations.*

**LOCATION:** NYC \| In\-Person (Monday through Thursday, additional days as needed)


**Who are we?**


Influencer is a global creator marketing agency on a mission to shape the future of marketing by humanizing brands. By placing creators at the center, the agency delivers creator\-first solutions across creative, media, and commerce that connect brands with audiences through insight\-driven creator campaigns built to stop the scroll and drive measurable impact.


Founded in 2015 by YouTuber\-turned\-entrepreneur Caspar Lee and entrepreneur Ben Jeffries, Influencer is the world’s largest independent creator marketing agency \- powered by a unique ecosystem of proprietary technology, platform partnerships, and longstanding talent relationships.


As an Official Global Marketing Partner of TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Snap, Meta, and Twitch, Influencer delivers bespoke, enterprise\-level solutions powered by Waves, its AI\-driven operating system. From concept to conversion, the agency blends human instinct with platform intelligence to drive measurable outcomes across the full funnel \- from brand perception to performance and sales.


With 200\+ team members speaking 30 languages across North America, Europe, and the Middle East, Influencer has delivered 6,000\+ campaigns for leading brands including Spotify, SharkNinja, Google, Nike, Disney, and Coca\-Cola.

**Job title**


IT Operations Specialist


**Reporting of the role**


IT Manager

**Overview of the job**

**Technical Support \& Helpdesk Operations:** Monitor and manage the Service Desk to prioritize and resolve Tier 1 \& 2 support tickets efficiently (break/fix issues, MacOS troubleshooting, desktop/laptop/tablet/printer support, drive/account access) both in\-person and remotely.  

  

**User Account \& Lifecycle Management (JML Process):** Support end\-to\-end onboarding, provisioning, deprovisioning, and offboarding for new and departing employees across system accounts (Google Workspace, Slack, Office 365, other enterprise software tools). Execute SSO configuration, SCIM provisioning \& physical device collection and delivery.

**User Enablement:** Lead Day 1 technical onboarding for US staff by provisioning hardware and software access, and guiding new hires through essential self\-service resources, such as our knowledge management system and our internal app catalog.  

  

**Hardware \& Software Asset Management:** Maintain an accurate inventory of all IT equipment, software, peripherals, spare units, and licenses. Oversee Mac setup, deployment, standard imaging, repairs, upgrades, and shipping devices to/from employees. Maintain and repair hardware as directed by the IT Manager.  

  

**Mobile Device Management (MDM) \& Security:** Utilize MDM solutions (Addigy) for device provisioning, policy enforcement, system patch management, and implementing infrastructure security best practices  

  

**Audio/Visual \& Event Technical Support:** Set up, maintain, and troubleshoot in\-office AV equipment (HP Poly with Google Meet) and provide technical support during agency events  

  

**Documentation \& Project Assistance:** Document internal IT policies, procedures, and technical guides. Work alongside IT Manager to assist in daily administration, software/hardware upgrades, and technical guidance on projects. Ensure our internal knowledge management platform (Guru) is consistently kept up to date and optimized.

**Additional Duties:** Perform additional responsibilities as assigned to support evolving organizational needs or departmental goals.

**3 best things about the job**

* **Direct Mentorship:** Working alongside the IT Manager in a fast\-paced environment gives you direct, hands\-on exposure across a wide technical stack
* **Global Scale:** Supporting a high\-growth, global creator marketing agency means managing a modern, hybrid tech ecosystem (Google Workspace, Office 365, Addigy MDM, AV setups) that directly powers cross\-border collaboration.
* **High\-Impact**: Rather than being restricted to a single silo, you get to take part in end\-to\-end ownership, ranging from day\-to\-day user support and onboarding, to infrastructure upgrades, security implementation, and live event assistance.

**Measures of success \- in the first few months, you will have:**

* Successfully deployed and optimized the internal Service Desk portal to streamline employee support requests.
* Partnered with the IT Manager to transition toward a fully in\-house IT infrastructure, including the rollout of EDR and backup solutions.
* Conducted a comprehensive audit of all NYC office hardware to ensure asset management and inventory accuracy.
* Built strong relationships with the NYC employees, and established yourself as the face of IT.

**Roles \& responsibilities:**

* 2\+ years of hands\-on IT support experience across Windows and macOS environments, ideally within a fast\-paced or growing organization.
* Experience in Tier 1/2 troubleshooting, user onboarding/offboarding (JML processes), and identity management using Google Workspace and Office 365\.
* Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical staff and deliver a high standard of customer support.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to manage tickets independently, document technical processes.
* Proven ability to pivot quickly and adapt to emerging tech solutions or internal workflow adjustments.
* Proactive mindset focused on troubleshooting and identifying technical issues before becoming widespread disruptions.

**Requirements: Nice to Have:**

* Experience using AI tools to connect, automate, and streamline workflows
* An interest in content creation and / or the creator community

jobs.description:

As an essential part of the Retail Operations team, you will ensure all inventory, deliveries, and stockroom activities are handled accurately and efficiently. **Stockroom \& Logistics Operations (40%)**


* Handle deliveries and shipments, including scheduling and tracking shipments
* Assist with the preparation of inventory audits and regular stock counts
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, and cleanliness standards in the stockroom and storage areas
* Monitor product quality, report damaged goods, and handle returns or defective products
* Receive, unpack, and organize merchandise
* Monitor and maintain the stockroom by organizing products and supplies
* Ensure timely and accurate restocking of merchandise on the sales floor
* Prepare merchandise for floor sets

* Provide the sales team with quick and accurate information regarding stock availability
* Ensure products are available for customers when needed
* Run product from BOH to FOH to support customer purchases and restocking
* Be customer\-focused, and prepared to support customer service and sales at all times i.e. operate the cash register, greet customers, support customers in the fitting room, etc.

* Provide the sales team with quick and accurate information regarding stock availability
* Execute early morning and late evening store merchandising

**What you’ll bring:**


* Strong ability to manage multiple tasks, organize stock, and meet deadlines efficiently.
* Excellent eye for detail when handling inventory to ensure accuracy in stock management.
* Collaborates well with others to maintain stockroom efficiency and ensure smooth coordination with the sales team.
* Ability to identify and resolve inventory discrepancies or stock issues quickly and effectively

**Additional Requirements:**


* Previous experience in a retail or stockroom role (preferred)
* Ability to lift and carry heavy boxes, as required by company needs
* Basic computer skills for managing inventory systems
* Flexible schedule with weekend availability

**Our Perks:**


Clothing Allowance: Kotn team members are given an annual clothing allowance and discount.

KOTN Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to contribute to our mission.

KOTN Inc. is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require accommodation during the application or interview process, please notify the hiring manager of the role.

jobs.title: Treasury Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.



Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100\+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer\-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.



We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30\-year\-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world\-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.



We're a team of 170\+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.


Lithic's Treasury Operations team owns the movement of money across our card issuing infrastructure — network settlement, sponsor bank transfers, and the reconciliation that keeps it all provable. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role for someone who wants to learn the inner workings of payments and fintech infrastructure, not just observe them from a reporting layer.



You'll be running a critical, time\-sensitive engine every day — and at the same time, working alongside the Head of Treasury Operations to improve how that engine works as the function scales. You’ll also work cross\-functionally across a wide range of teams (Finance, Treasury Engineering, Risk, Analytics, Processing, Customer Success, Bank Operations) — this role sits at the center of a lot of different workflows, not off in a silo.


**What You'll Do**
------------------



Execution (50%)


* Own day\-to\-day execution of network settlement transfers (Mastercard, Visa) and related treasury transfers across sponsor banks
* Operate in a time\-sensitive environment where errors or delays have immediate downstream consequences
* Support reconciliation and ensure transfers tie out against expected activity
* Be a reliable, detail\-oriented operator of an existing process — accuracy and consistency matter as much as speed


Process Optimization (20%)


* Take existing workflows and make them better: fewer manual steps, stronger controls, cleaner audit trails
* Identify friction or risk in current processes and propose (and build) improvements
* Balance improvement work against the need for strong financial controls — nothing gets streamlined at the expense of auditability


Project Support (30%)


* Support the Head of Treasury Operations on larger initiatives as the function scales
* Contribute analysis, documentation, and execution support to new treasury infrastructure, reporting, or process builds


Ongoing


* Run ad hoc data analysis (SQL, Excel) to answer operational and financial questions on the fly
* Support downstream audit and reporting needs tied to settlement and reconciliation activity
* Be available outside normal business hours in rare emergency situations (e.g., a failed settlement or bank\-side issue)

**What You'll Learn**
---------------------



This role is a front\-row seat to the nuts and bolts of card issuing and payments infrastructure — network settlement mechanics, sponsor bank relationships, and the guts of how money actually moves through a modern fintech stack. You'll come out of this role with a depth of operational fintech knowledge that's hard to get anywhere else.


**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


* 2–4 years of relevant experience in treasury operations, funds transfer/money movement operations, cash management, or a closely adjacent operational finance role
* Experience with reconciliation and financial controls — you understand *why* the numbers need to tie out, not just how to make them tie out
* Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills, including comfort with (or willingness to learn) Google Apps Script for automating recurring workflows
* SQL proficiency for querying and validating data (we use Snowflake and Metabase); Python or other scripting is a plus, not a requirement
* Working comprehension of accounting concepts and financial operations / money movement (ACH, wires, card settlement, or similar) — you should be knowledgeable about how transfers and reconciliation tie back to the books
* Familiarity with Jira and Slack, or similar ticketing and collaboration tools, for tracking progress and coordinating across teams
* Comfort shifting flexibly between fixed process workflows and operating in an agile enrivonment (sprints, tickets, iterative process improvement)
* Interest in operating in a fast\-moving startup/fintech environment — this isn't a traditional back\-office treasury seat


The annual US salary range for this role is $80,000 \- $110,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.



This is a hybrid position. Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to our NYC office in Soho. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.

### **Benefits for Full\-Time US Employees:**


* Unlimited PTO
* 12\-weeks fully paid parental leave
* 4\-Week Fully Paid Sabbatical (earned at your 5\-year anniversary)
* Work From Anywhere: work from anywhere in the world 4\-weeks each year
* 3% cashback on card purchases with your complimentary Privacy.com employee account
* Health, vision, and dental insurance; HSA Contribution Match
* 401(k) match
* Voluntary Life Insurance and STD/LTD


NYC\-based employees work from our SoHo office three days a week. Tuesdays and Thursdays are our core days, and you'll choose a third day that works for your schedule and team needs.

* Commuter benefit

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and energized by making complex workflows run smoothly. They take pride in creating order, building reliable processes, and helping cross\-functional teams work more efficiently.


This person brings a service mindset, strong follow\-through, and a sense of ownership to every task. They are comfortable working independently, shifting priorities in a fast\-paced environment, and using data to track progress, identify issues, and communicate status clearly.


A successful Sample Operations Coordinator is not only accurate and dependable, but also curious about how the process can improve. They are confident working across teams, asking the right questions, and helping create a sample management function that is scalable, visible, and trusted.


*Essential Functions*

* **Sample Process Ownership**

Manage the timely receipt, unboxing, identification, and logging of sample shipments. Maintain accurate sample records in tracking systems, including PLM and Airtable.
* **Reporting \& Communication**  

Create and maintain sample reporting standards to provide visibility to shipment status, outstanding issues, and priority needs.
* **Sample Room \& Workroom Organization**  

Partner with Design and Product Development teams to maintain organized and functional sample workrooms. Support process improvements that make samples easier to locate, review, and manage.
* **Milestone, Mock Store \& Photoshoot Support**  

Coordinate sample set\-up for product reviews and photoshoots. Partner with teams to ensure priority samples are available, staged, and ready for review.
* **Shipment Issue Resolution**  

Monitor third\-party shipping issues, lost shipments, delayed deliveries, and sample discrepancies.
* **Process Improvement \& Ownership**  

Identify opportunities to improve sample flow, organization, reporting, and communication. Bring forward ideas that increase efficiency, reduce sample loss, improve visibility, and strengthen Sample Operations as a reliable operational function.

jobs.title: Research Coordinator – Women’s Brain Health Research
jobs.description:
In this role, the successful candidate will independently coordinate and manage the day\-to\-day conduct of an NIH\-funded research study on **women’s brain health** (RF1AG098531\) conducted at the NYU Grossman School of Medicine. The Research Coordinator exercises independent judgment and discretion in managing study operations, resolving protocol and regulatory issues, determining participant eligibility, and analyzing study data — serving as the primary point of accountability for the study’s day\-to\-day scientific and operational integrity, under the general direction of the Principal Investigators.

  

  

  

### **Project**

  

  

This NIH\-funded project, led by Drs. Erika Raven and Jelle Veraart, focuses on improving women’s brain health by identifying why the menopause transition may increase the risk of cognitive decline and Alzheimer’s disease. Using longitudinal neuroimaging, plasma proteomics, and detailed clinical assessments of a prospective cohort, the study examines how hormonal changes and menopausal hormone therapy influence brain aging and cognitive outcomes. The goal is to define sex\-specific biomarkers and risk profiles that support earlier detection, more precise prevention, and clinically meaningful strategies to protect women’s health across midlife and aging.


### **Job Responsibilities**


**Study Coordination \& Regulatory Compliance**
* Independently manage the day\-to\-day operations of the study, exercising judgment to resolve protocol deviations, scheduling conflicts, and other non\-routine issues as they arise, escalating to the PIs only when appropriate
* Interpret and apply IRB and sponsor requirements; prepare, submit, and track continuing reviews, amendments, and reportable events, determining the appropriate course of action for ambiguous or non\-routine regulatory situations

**Participant Recruitment, Screening \& Eligibility Determination**
* Independently review medical records and screening data against complex study eligibility criteria; exercise judgment on borderline or ambiguous cases and make enrollment recommendations to the Principal Investigators
* Lead the informed consent process, ensuring participants understand study procedures, risks, and rights; manage enrollment, scheduling, and long\-term follow\-up of a prospective cohort

**Data Collection \& Quality Oversight**
* Coordinate and, where applicable, assist with MRI data collection, cognitive testing, and survey administration; select and adapt procedures to participant\-specific circumstances (e.g., menopause status, scheduling constraints) within study guidelines
* Oversee blood sample collection, storage, and shipping logistics for the plasma proteomics component of the study, ensuring compliance with protocol and chain\-of\-custody requirements

**Data Analysis, Reporting \& Team Liaison**
* Consolidate and analyze longitudinal clinical, imaging, and biomarker data; identify trends and data quality issues, and prepare summaries and recommendations that inform manuscript development and study reporting
* Serve as the primary liaison between the PIs, study team members, core facilities, and external collaborators, exercising discretion in coordinating cross\-functional study activities
### **Required Qualifications**


Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a related discipline is required, along with a minimum of 2 years of clinical or human subjects research experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Must demonstrate the ability to exercise independent judgment and discretion in coordinating study operations, resolving non\-routine issues, and interfacing with participants, investigators, and regulatory bodies with minimal supervision. Effective oral and written communication and interpersonal skills, along with strong time management, organizational, and analytical skills, are required.
### **Preferred Qualifications**


Knowledge of basic medical terminology is preferred. Prior experience independently coordinating research protocols, and working with EPIC and REDCap, is preferred. Experience working in an academic medical center environment, and prior experience training or guiding junior research staff, is also preferred.


### **About Us**


NYU Grossman School of Medicine provides its staff with far more than just a place to work. Rather, we are an institution you can be proud of, an institution where you’ll feel good about devoting your time and your talents. At NYU Langone Health, we are committed to supporting our workforce and their loved ones with a comprehensive benefits and wellness package. Our offerings provide a robust support system for any stage of life, whether it’s developing your career, starting a family, or saving for retirement. The support employees receive goes beyond a standard benefit offering, where employees have access to financial security benefits, a generous time\-off program and employee resources groups for peer support. Additionally, all employees have access to our holistic employee wellness program, which focuses on seven key areas of well\-being: physical, mental, nutritional, sleep, social, financial, and preventive care. The benefits and wellness package is designed to allow you to focus on what truly matters. Join us and experience the extensive resources and services designed to enhance your overall quality of life for you and your family.


NYU Grossman School of Medicine is an equal opportunity employer and committed to inclusion in all aspects of recruiting and employment. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration. We require applications to be completed online.

jobs.description:
Once EasyWMS has been implemented and the project is completed, customers need ongoing support to ensure the system continues to operate reliably and provide value to their warehouse operations.


The Technical Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for supporting customers in three key areas:

* **Customer Support:** Help customers as they continue learning and using EasyWMS in their daily operations.
* **Issue Resolution:** Coordinate the investigation and resolution of software and system issues.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Gather customer feedback, identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities, and help translate them into actions that improve EasyWMS and the customer experience.


The TAM acts as the main communication link between the customer, the U.S. support team, and technical teams in Spain.


**Responsibilities:**

**1\. Customer Support \& Incident Management**

* Attend the **Technical Support Hotline** when customers need to speak directly with the Mecalux support team.
* Understand the customer's issue and ensure that a support ticket is properly created.
* Troubleshoot low\-severity issues when possible.
* Escalate higher\-severity issues to the appropriate technical team and ensure someone is actively working on the problem.
* Monitor open tickets and ensure issues are progressing according to the applicable SLA.
* Help prioritize issues based on their impact on warehouse operations.
* Conduct recurring meetings with customers to review open issues and their progress.
* Act as the main communication contact during high\-priority incidents.
* Provide clear and timely updates to customers and internal stakeholders during active incidents.
* Maintain accurate records of incidents, root causes, and corrective actions.
* Coordinate communication between U.S. customers and technical resources in Spain to ensure clear and effective communication.

**2\. Technical Support Coordination**

* Coordinate software patches, configuration changes, system updates, and other technical activities.
* Help investigate recurring software or service failures and identify their root causes.
* Identify process changes that can prevent issues from recurring or reduce their impact when they cannot be completely avoided.
* Follow up on corrective actions until they are fully implemented.

**3\. Change Request Management**

* Manage the implementation of customer Change Requests.
* Coordinate the administrative process in SAP.
* Schedule work with internal technical teams and customers.
* Follow up on implementation progress.
* Evaluate the impact of changes after implementation.

**4\. Customer Relationship \& Continuous Improvement**


Through regular customer meetings, ticket analysis, and operational feedback:

* Monitor customer satisfaction with EasyWMS.
* Monitor customer satisfaction with the Remote Support service.
* Identify recurring issues and support trends.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer processes and the EasyWMS product.
* Gather customer feedback and translate it into actionable product improvement opportunities.
* Bachelor's degree in **Information Technology, Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field**.
* **English:** At least C2 proficiency.

* Good understanding of **warehouse operations and distribution center processes**.
* Professional communication skills, with a customer\-focused mindset.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to multi\-task and problem\-solve in high\-pressure situations
* Previous related experience is preferred.
* Previous exposure to WMS, ERP, or supply chain software is preferred.

jobs.description:
The DERMS Operations Specialist plays a crucial role in the development and implementation of the Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS). This newly created position offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of innovation, laying the groundwork for the expansion of energy management within the distribution system. The DERMS Operations Specialist is responsible for the real\-time and near\-real\-time operational integration of Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) on the electric distribution system. This role ensures DERs are operated safely, reliably, and in compliance with grid constraints, using DERMS and related advanced distribution applications. The specialist serves as a technical bridge between distribution system operators, planning, IT/OT systems, and DER programs.


Currently, DERMS is in Phase I of implementation, focusing on visibility of the distribution system. During this stage, the DERMS Operations Specialist will maintain system awareness, monitor distributed resources, and evaluate load and generation forecasts. As the program prepares for Phase II, which includes system optimization and dispatch, the DERMS Operations Specialist will contribute to the development of user interfaces, tools, and processes necessary for seamless and reliable DERMS operations. As new distributed resources are integrated, the specialist will ensure communication paths are established for real\-time monitoring and dispatch.


This role will initially follow a hybrid work schedule, with four days per week, Monday through Thursday, at the office located at 241 Ralph McGill.


  
**Georgia Power** is the largest electric subsidiary of Southern Company (NYSE: SO), America's premier energy company. Value, Reliability, Customer Service and Stewardship are the cornerstones of the Company's promise to 2\.6 million customers in all but four of Georgia's 159 counties. jobs.title: Pricing Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
* Peachtree Corners, GA, United States / Sunnyvale, CA, United States
* Not Remote
* Finance \& Accounting
* JOB218596


  
### **Company Description**


It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.


We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.


The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.


If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.


### **Job Description**


**Primary Function of Position:**


We are seeking a process\-oriented Pricing Operations Specialist to support how pricing reaches the customer: the global price books that carry it, the contracted pricing that governs it, and the Configure Price Quote (CPQ) system that executes it.


Pricing operations is where commercial strategy becomes real. This role designs the processes and system logic that make quoting accurate, fast, and simple for the sales teams and customers who depend on it, and serves as the practical expert on what can be delivered within existing system constraints: what is achievable, in what sequence, and at what operational cost.


Partnering with regional pricing, Sales Operations, Contracts, Customer Service, Product Management, and Systems teams, the Analyst will create excellence in the transaction experience, quoting process, and pricing fidelity across the quote\-to\-cash continuum. Success in this role is measured less by analysis produced than by how reliably price is executed worldwide.


**Roles \& Responsibilities:**


**Price Book Management**


* Support creation and maintenance of global price books, including new product introductions, list price changes, regional variants, effective dating, and ongoing accuracy.
* Drive the pricing release calendar, coordinating change windows with commercial, regional, and systems stakeholders.

**Contract\-Based Pricing**


* Activate and maintain contracted, deviated, and tiered customer pricing in CPQ and ERP, including GPO and IDN agreement terms, membership eligibility, and price expiration tracking.
* Research and resolve price discrepancies across quote, order, and invoice, correcting the underlying system condition rather than the individual transaction.
* Support the discount approval process for local commercial leader price decisions.

**Systems and Configuration**


* Configure and maintain CPQ pricing logic, discounting rules, and approval workflows.
* Perform regression testing of pricing logic following each system change or price book release.
* Partner with Systems and IT on CPQ build, enhancement scoping, and defect resolution.

**Process Design and Optimization**


* Design, document, and improve repeatable price execution processes, removing friction across the quote\-to\-cash continuum.
* Evaluate trade\-offs between process change and system change, and recommend the approach that delivers the outcome soonest at acceptable operational cost.

**Enablement and Customer Experience**


* Train and enable sales, sales operations, and regional pricing teams on quoting and price execution, acting as the first point of contact for how\-to questions.
* Improve the quoting and purchasing experience for sales teams and customers, treating both as the customer of this function.

**Controls and Reporting**


* Maintain controls and audit\-ready documentation for all price book and contract pricing changes.
* Report on price execution accuracy and quoting cycle time, and act on the trends that surface.

### **Qualifications**


**Required Skills and Experience:**


* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in pricing operations, sales operations, order management, contract administration, or business process roles, including a minimum of 2 years of hands\-on CPQ configuration.
* Hands\-on configuration experience with a CPQ platform, including pricing rules and approval workflows.
* Direct experience administering contracted or deviated customer pricing.
* Demonstrated process design and process mapping capability, with clear written documentation.
* Attention to detail and accuracy when working with high\-volume pricing data.
* Ability to identify workable solutions inside a fixed system, and to explain trade\-offs between process change and system change to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Service orientation toward internal partners and external customers.
* Advanced Excel skills, with working knowledge of Tableau.
* Strong collaborator across time zones and functions, with a focus on process integration and optimization.
* This role requires approximately 10% travel, including international travel.
* This role requires working onsite in either our Sunnyvale, CA or Peachtree Corners, GA office Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday every week.

**Required Education and Training**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Operations, or a related field

**Preferred Skills and Experience**


* Background in or familiarity with the healthcare industry, medical devices, and hospital operations.
* Familiarity with GPO and IDN contract structures and healthcare contract administration.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP or a comparable ERP system, and ownership of price books or comparable master data.
* Experience applying generative AI tools to process auto

We're reimagining the critical work that happens behind the scenes, bringing visibility, efficiency, and impact to the processes that keep classrooms running. By streamlining the complex, automating the routine, and surfacing the insights that matter most, we can create the conditions for educators to teach, students to thrive, and districts to shape the future of education.

**Sales Development Representative Overview:**

  



Reporting directly to the Revenue Operations Leader, the Sales Development Representative SDR) will be responsible for generating interest and qualifying leads with target school districts within assigned territories.

  



The SDR will work actively with our field sales team to identify target school districts and implement outreach cadences to generate and qualify leads for our products. The GDR will also work extensively within our marketing automation and AI\-powered tools to identify, develop, and qualify leads for our field sales team. This role also manages and maintains our lead process protocols to ensure all qualified sales leads are properly distributed and tracked in our sales support systems.

  



Our Sales Development Team thrives on culture and collaboration, so working together 2\-3 days a week in one of our two offices \- Alpharetta and Atlanta \- is required.

  


**Sales Development Representative Responsibilities:**


* Generate new business pipeline primarily through outbound prospecting
* Operate within RevOps at the intersection of Sales and Marketing, working inside a centrally coordinated outreach cadence that sequences prospect touches across Demand Gen, SDR, and Sales to prevent duplicate or conflicting outreach
* Design effective outbound prospecting sequences to effectively contact target school districts
* Engage and qualify prospects using agentic\-powered workflows, insights, and automated intelligence
* Utilize AI agents to research accounts, tailor messaging, and execute high\-quality outreach at scale, alongside core sales tech stack
* Activate demand by delivering personalized engagement across email, phone, social, and in\-product channels
* Partner with Demand Generation to act on campaign and account signals in real time, prioritizing outreach based on the most current marketing and sales intelligence available
* Carry and consistently deliver against a quota and activity metrics, tracked through Salesforce/Gong, and reported in a weekly goal\-setting and readout cadence
* Represent Incident IQ at industry conferences, trade shows, and marketing\-hosted events, including independently engaging prospects and conducting account drop\-ins as needed
* Work strategically with your field sales partner on a Go\-to\-Market strategy

  


**Sales Development Representative Requirements:**


* Four (4\) year college degree, or equivalent
* Experience or interest in working with AI\-powered sales engagement tools to improve prospecting efficiency and outreach quality
* Sales tech experience \- Primarily Salesforce, Gong, and Qualified to maximize performance and efficiency
* High energy, high activity personality and personal drive

 **What makes Incident IQ different:**


* We facilitate whole\-person growth where employees can develop personally as well as professionally.
* We offer an energetic and collaborative environment; everyone's opinion matters!
* We produce software that empowers K\-12 schools to run efficiently, allowing for a better classroom experience for students to THRIVE!
* We provide excellent work/life balance. Two amazing offices \- a Downtown Atlanta office location and one at Halcyon in Alpharetta!

  



Incident IQ offers a competitive salary based on experience with a benefits package for full\-time employees that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401k match, and paid\-time off (PTO).

  




*Incident IQ is an Equal Opportunity Employer*

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Syndigo gets great products chosen. Every choice in commerce, whether by a shopper, a search engine, a marketplace, or an AI assistant, is made on product data, and our software makes that data complete and trusted and moves it across the industry's largest two\-sided commerce network: 15,000\+ brands and 3,500\+ retailers. Companies like AutoZone, Colgate\-Palmolive, Dole International, Unilever, and Walgreens trust Syndigo to get their products chosen. Learn more at www.syndigo.com.

**\*\*This is a hybrid position that requires 2 days per week in office at our Chicago location\*\***



The **Project Coordinator** supports the delivery of product content and data across recipient programs. This role manages workflows, monitors progress, maintains accurate program information, and helps resolve day\-to\-day issues that may affect content delivery or publication outcomes.



Working closely with Program Management, Customer Success, Operations, Product, Engineering, suppliers, and other stakeholders, the Project Coordinator provides hands\-on operational support for strategic programs. The role is well suited for someone who is highly organized, detail oriented, comfortable working with data, and motivated to improve the customer and recipient experience.


**HOW WE'LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY**


* Coordinate day\-to\-day activities, workflows, milestones, and deliverables across assigned recipient and retailer programs.
* Support strategic programs by monitoring product content as it moves through Syndigo workflows and identifying rejected, stalled, incomplete, or underperforming items.
* Partner with Program Managers, Customer Success Managers, Operations, Product, Engineering, suppliers, brands, and other stakeholders to help remove blockers and keep work progressing.
* Support Mandarin\-speaking suppliers and vendors participating in import vendor programs through clear business communication, onboarding, training, and ongoing operational coordination.
* Prepare and maintain weekly, monthly, and ad hoc reports for recipient programs.
* Research and respond to customer and stakeholder requests in a timely manner, ensuring appropriate follow\-through and escalation when needed.
* Review data and program outputs for completeness, accuracy, and quality in accordance with documented requirements.
* Communicate program status, risks, delays, and dependencies clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
* Assist with additional operational, reporting, documentation, and program coordination tasks based on business priorities.


**WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU**


* 1 to 3 years of experience in project coordination, operations, customer success, program support, business analysis, or a related client\-facing role
* Experience in a software\-as\-a\-service, retail, e\-commerce, product content, data management, or syndication environment preferred
* Professional working proficiency in Mandarin Chinese and English, with the ability to support business conversations, onboarding, and training for Mandarin\-speaking program participants
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with customers, suppliers, and cross\-functional teams
* Knowledge of Microsoft Excel and reporting tools
* Experience with Jira, SharePoint, or similar operational tools is a plus
* Ability to work independently after training while remaining collaborative, responsive, and accountable for follow\-through
* Comfortable learning new software, workflows, and data processes

**Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion**
----------------------------------



To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating. Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it's how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful!



All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth!


**GDPR/CCPA**



Syndigo, to process applications, holds onto data for a "reasonable time" after applications are submitted. This data is stored for Syndigo's internal use by HR/Recruiting Staff only. Verified requests for data deletion and exports will be completed upon request.


**Syndigo Job Applicant Privacy Notice**



At Syndigo, we care about your privacy. As you go through our recruitment process, we are committed to being transparent about how we process your personal data. To learn more about how Syndigo processes your personal data, go to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

We are committed to providing clean, reliable, and affordable energy in an environmentally sustainable manner. Customers are the heart of our business, and we work every day to help grow and support communities where we provide vital energy services.

  

As a Fortune 500 company, we value and develop our employees who are making a difference in a mission that matters. jobs.title: Mentoring Program Coordinator - Leaders of Tomorrow
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Join our dynamic team as a Mentoring Program Coordinator for the Leaders of Tomorrow initiative! In this role, you will be at the forefront of empowering youth and fostering community engagement through innovative mentoring programs. Your energy, leadership, and organizational skills will drive the success by creating meaningful connections that inspire growth and development. This position offers an exciting opportunity to make a tangible impact while honing your project management and community engagement expertise.

This role is ideal for motivated individuals passionate about leadership development and community service. If you thrive in fast paced environments where your proactive approach can foster meaningful change apply today to become a vital part of our mission to empower tomorrow’s leaders!

**POSITION SUMMARY** 

Under the supervision of the Director of Youth Services, the **Leaders of Tomorrow School\-Based Group Mentoring Program Coordinator** will oversee all programmatic and administrative aspects of group mentoring services at Shields Middle School. The LOT Mentoring Program Coordinator is responsible for working collaboratively with school staff to recruit prospective youth participants, coordinate scheduling of group sessions, oversee the implementation of the group curriculum, supervise the LOT Mentor to ensure high quality service delivery, and provide direct group mentoring services to youth participants. The Program Coordinator should be passionate about supporting youth development and working collaboratively with students, families, and school staff to help middle school youth attain holistic well\-being.

This is a year\-round position and requires a flexible work schedule that accommodates students and their families.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Oversee recruitment of eligible group mentoring participants
* Work with school staff to schedule group mentoring sessions without disrupting instruction
* Develop and implement individualized strategies to sustain consistent youth engagement in group mentoring services over time, in collaboration with school staff, the LOT Mentor, and parents or guardians as appropriate
* Oversee the implementation of BPNC’s evidence\-informed group mentoring curriculum
* Provide ongoing individual supervision to the LOT Mentor based at Chicago Public School located on the southwest side of Chicago, in order to ensure high quality service delivery
* Deliver group mentoring services to youth participants
* Participate in continuous improvement sessions with the City of Chicago Department of Family and Support Services to review data, monitor progress, and assess youth outcomes
* In consultation with the LOT mentor and mentees, plan and facilitate quarterly, youth\-led outings that are developmentally appropriate and focus on areas of support identified by the youth themselves
* Collaborate with external partners to connect youth to additional services and resources as needed
* Maintain a positive work atmosphere by behaving and communicating in an appropriate and respectful manner with supervisees, students, school, agency staff, and parents
* Participate in regular staff meetings, staff trainings, supervisory sessions and other duties as assigned by the supervisor
* Adhere to agency policy, procedures and the professional code of ethics
* Perform other related duties as assigned

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor's degree required
* At least 1 year of supervisory experience preferred
* At least 2 years of experience providing mentoring support to school age children and adolescents
* Must be over 24 years old
* Required bilingual in Spanish
* Sensitive to needs of low\-income/immigrant youth and their families
* Must be highly organized, self\-motivated and comfortable working independently
* Ability to travel between different work sites
* Ability to pass a routine background check as well as a Chicago Public Schools background check

Pay: $60,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

* Are you over 24 years old?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Supervising: 1 year (Required)
* Mentoring: 2 years (Preferred)

Language:

* English and Spanish (Required)

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Location**

GGP Chicago \- 350 N Orleans Street, Suite 300
**Business**

Headquartered in Chicago, IL, GGP is a leading retail real estate company with a portfolio of 95\+ high\-performing retail assets, encompassing over 95 million square feet of space across the United States. As an owner\-operator, we’re committed to creating vibrant destinations that bring people and brands together. With a team of 1,200\+ employees and a legacy of leadership in retail real estate, we’re shaping the future of the industry by delivering exceptional value to our partners and the communities we serve


If you’re ready to be a part of our team, we encourage you to apply.


**Job Description**

GGP has an immediate need for a **Marketing Coordinator** at our Chicago office.


Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Tenant Success, with a dotted line to the Chief Marketing Officer, the Marketing Coordinator is an hourly employee that serves as a vital resource for the Marketing team, providing tenant marketing coordination, marketing assistance, and administrative support.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Tenant Success support**
--------------------------

* Support the Sr. Manager, Tenant Success in the project management and implementation of prioritized tenant events and activations
* Coordinate the trafficking of retailer assets to support new store openings via digital channels across the portfolio
* Track all marketing, Strategic Partnership (GGP Media), and Property Management support for prioritized new store openings
* Assist with a variety of project management, event, and promotional program needs, including (but not limited to) developing sweepstakes rules with Legal as well as the sourcing and fulfillment of prizes or other event elements
* Develop and maintain the overall new store opening calendar and associated project plans and own overall successful execution of said plans

**Marketing support**
---------------------

* Manage budgeting tasks, including expense management, invoice processing, and monthly accruals for accounting
* Publish web and social content
* Collaborate with Legal and Risk Management on contractual agreements as needed
* Other assigned duties as needed

**Administrative for Head of Marketing**
----------------------------------------

* Assist in the daily business of department and team functions, such as coordinating meeting communication and flow, shipping and packaging, and assisting in team outings
* Support companywide cultural initiatives such as philanthropy events, monthly cultural programming, Leadership Conference, Town Halls, and Holiday Party
* Travel and expense management for Head of Marketing
* PowerPoint and QA support
* Other assigned duties as needed

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Education**
-------------

* High school diploma or GED required
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, real estate, hospitality, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience

**Experience**
--------------

* Experience working in cross\-functional, stakeholder\-driven environments
* Experience with invoicing/contract management a plus
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, Power Point)

**Skills**
----------

* Strong project management skills with strong attention to detail
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Strong collaboration with a willingness to jump in and learn
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple activations simultaneously
* Have the ability to wear multiple hats, roll up sleeves and demonstrate proactivity

**Physical Requirements \& Work Environment**
---------------------------------------------

* Standard business hours, Monday through Friday in\-office environment
* Occasional evening or weekend work may be required to support business continuity during high\-volume tenant opening periods, activations, or time\-sensitive tenant needs

**Compensation**

* Salary type: Non\-Exempt
* Pay Frequency: Bi\-weekly
* Hourly Pay Range: $24\.00 \- $33\.65/hour
* Annual Bonus: 10%

**Benefit Information**

* Competitive compensation
* Medical, Dental and Vision beginning day 1
* 401(k) Company matching
* 401(k) Vests on Day 1
* Career development programs
* Charitable donation matching
* Generous paid time off (i.e., vacation, personal holidays, paid sick time)
* Paid Volunteer Hours
* Paid Parental Leave
* Family planning assistance including IVF, surrogacy, and adoption options
* Wellness and mental health resources
* Pet insurance offering
* Childcare Assistance
* Commuter benefits
* A culture on our values of Act with Integrity, Build Mutual Trust, Take Initiative and Win Together.

We are proud to create a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are grateful for your interest in this position, however, only candidates selected for pre\-screening will be contacted.
\#GGP

jobs.description:

Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a **Sales Liason and Catering \& Events Coordinator** , you’re not just supporting sales operations and lead generation to help drive new business – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.


  
Here's what you'll do during a typical day:


* **Perform daily sales operations:** Provide administrative support including data entry, invoice distribution, Salesforce activity tracking, and recordkeeping to ensure efficient team operations
* **Support sales documentation and reporting:** Assist with preparing contracts, proposals, RFP responses, client call summaries, and booking and loyalty reports
* **Generate and qualify new business leads:** Research, identify, and evaluate unmanaged and prospect accounts to build and maintain a qualified pipeline
* **Build collaborative relationships:** Partner with Hilton Worldwide Sales peers, customers, and hotel partners to identify and qualify new opportunities, conduct discovery calls for unmanaged accounts, and deliver tailored solutions
* **Assist with special projects and events:** Support departmental initiatives, customer engagement activities, and participation in meetings and conferences as needed

  
**What It Takes to Make the Stay**

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of **Hospitality** . Acting with **Integrity** and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through **Leadership** . A belief that **Teamwork** drives the best outcomes. A sense of **Ownership** and accountability. And a focus on the **Now** , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.


  
**How We'll Help You Thrive**

At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including\*:


* **Incredible travel perks** – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40/night at our world\-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
* **Own a piece of Hilton** – Through our employee stock purchase program (ESPP), you can invest in Hilton shares at a 15% discount to help build your financial future
* **Paid parental leave** – Because family matters. We offer paid leave for eligible Team Members, including partners and adoptive parents

* **Mental health resources** – Your wellbeing comes first. Eligible Team Members can access free counseling and support through our best\-in\-class Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* **Generous paid time off (PTO)** – Recharge, relax, and take time for what matters most
* **Health \& welfare benefits** – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you and your family covered
* **Financial security for your future** – Our retirement plans make it easier to save for what’s next

*\*Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.*


  
**Join an Award\-Winning Workplace Culture**  

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.


**A Day in the Life**
=====================

We are seeking a committed professional to join our team. While this is a remote position not located at a physical Medtronic site, the candidate hired will be required to reside within the territory and drive to multiple accounts throughout the region. A valid driver's license is essential for this role.  

As one of three comprehensive portfolios at Medtronic, Neuroscience is dedicated to improving the lives of people living with neurological disorders, spine conditions, and chronic pain. Guided by our Mission—to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life—we develop technologies and therapies that help people regain function, reduce pain, and return to the activities that matter most.


Our Cranial \& Spinal Technologies (CST) Operating Unit develops and delivers an integrated ecosystem of spinal implants, navigation and robotic guidance systems, advanced imaging, and data\-driven planning tools for complex spine and cranial procedures. Platforms such as AiBLE™ connect these technologies to enhance surgical precision, streamline workflows, and support improved patient outcomes across the globe.


This role will support our Spine and Biologics business.


Click here to learn more about our full procedural solutions for spine surgery and


Click here to learn more about our bone grafting solutions for spinal fusion


Check us out on LinkedIn: Medtronic CST


At Medtronic, the Sales Representative II, Spine is responsible for making field sales calls, soliciting orders, selling assigned Medtronic Spinal and Biologics products and representing the company in accordance with its policies and in the assigned territory; for maintaining an awareness of local competitive conditions and for reporting back promptly to the district manager.


This is a **field based** role.

* Meeting or exceeding sales quota and total company market share in assigned territory
* Staying attentive to competitor’s product and merchandizing practices and keep the District Sales Manager informed
* Attending and participating in sales meetings, training programs, conventions, and trade shows as directed
* Assisting in the field training of any sales person as requested by the District Sales Manager
* Cooperating with all personnel on the execution of Company programs
* Creating and implementing an annual business plan with quarterly updates
* Submitting reports and provide information as directed

jobs.description:
As the Specialist Manager, Business Development Representative within the Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice, you will support our growing services practice **.** The Practice delivers focused Agentic Services with the client's chosen OpenAI technologies, bringing industry depth and technical rigor to every phase of their AI journey including ChatGPT Enterprise, domain\-based customer models, agentic workflows and frontier platforms as well as change management and cybersecurity.  

  

Business Development Representatives are members of a dynamic, co\-evolving community of individuals working together with Deloitte's Sales and Growth Platform organizations to create and capture value and position Deloitte's capabilities and expertise in the market across various technology platforms.  

  

This is a Deloitte business\-development role focused on identifying and shaping opportunities for permissible Deloitte professional services. It is not an OpenAI product\-sales, reseller, referral, channel, or joint\-selling role. The role operates through Deloitte account and pursuit teams and is independent from the operations from OpenAI.  

  

Deloitte can advise and implement OpenAI products and interact with OpenAI in a manner that adheres to the independence guardrails, consistent with the rules and policies of the Securities Exchange Commission.  

  

Recruiting for this role ends on 9/30/2026\.  

  

**Work you'll do**  

  

As a Specialist Manager, Business Development Representative for the Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice team, you will be responsible for:
  

* **Identifying top\-of\-funnel opportunities:** Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders across Deloitte account teams and the Practice. Participate in internal only account planning activities by identifying relevant opportunities while ensuring adherence with independence guidelines.
* **Building awareness of the practice:** Creating market and internal awareness of the Practice to source new leads and opportunities. Additionally, generate awareness and educate Deloitte practitioners on Deloitte's services capabilities while ensuring we are adhering to Independence Guidelines.
* **Support client relevant deliverables:** Assist Deloitte's go\-to\-market team in creating new industry or domain specific, success stories, quals and proposal submissions, focusing on Deloitte professional services. Initiate the development and execution of lead generation field events, collateral, case studies, videos, or white papers. Coordinate with account teams for follow\-ups and drive deal progression.
* **Partner across sales teams:** Engage with Deloitte internal sales teams to explore opportunities for cross\-sell/upsell across technologies, platforms, offerings (e.g. AI\&E, Human Capital, Customer etc.) and domains (Finance, Marketing, Supply Chain, HR etc.). Demonstrate comprehensive Industry sales coverage by generating new leads for sales executives.

  

**The successful candidate would possess these skills:**  

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

  

**The Team**  

  

This role sits within the Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice, under the Technology Relationships segment of Deloitte's Growth Platforms organization.  

  

Deloitte OpenAI Technology Practice is geared around advising, implementing, and operating solutions for our clients who have selected OpenAI's GenAI models (e.g. Enterprise, Codex, etc.). The practice offers solution engineering, technical enablement, and domain expertise to help organizations and Deloitte practitioners achieve their goals with artificial intelligence. We deliver hands\-on technical training, custom AI solutions, reusable tools, accelerators, and industry\-focused knowledge to address real\-world challenges, equipping both clients and Deloitte professionals with best practices, practical guidance, and collaborative networks to identify valuable AI opportunities and drive measurable outcomes.  

  

**Qualifications**  

  

Required:
  

* 5\+ years' experience in Technology or relevant Industry markets with an emphasis on significant business development and client relationship experience.
* Fluency in Cloud Analytics/Data Platforms and Agentic/AI technologies.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
* Ability to travel up to 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

  

Preferred:
  

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited school or university.
* Expert level understanding of Cloud marketplace and strong command on market messaging and presence for Cloud\-oriented professional services firms.
* Experience executing sales and capturing strategies and initiatives to transition underperforming IT organizations and programs to become customer\-centric and operate a service delivery model.
* Deep technical understanding of Cloud technologies e.g. Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI and other Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) as well as a demonstrated understanding of modern approaches to Cloud infrastructure, software development, and legacy systems modernization.
* Work with account and pursuit teams to architect large, complex capture efforts with teaming partners, staff, and practice leadership at all stages of the capture lifecycle.
* Prior experience working with major industries/vertical markets and experience with OpenAI technologies or comparable GenAI platforms is a plus.

You'll work alongside Sales Management and Production, and you'll be backed by a company that is serious about investing in its people and committed to their long\-term success.

new_jobs.title: ALA Shared Housing Program Coordinator VISTA
new_jobs.description:
ALA's Shared Housing program, established in 1978, has run continuously for 45 years and matched over 2500 individuals in home share arrangements. Shared Housing has been lauded by civic leaders as an effective alternative to traditional affordable housing. The program is intended to match 1\) seniors who own their homes, live alone, and wish to remain in their homes instead of institutionalization (a nursing home) with 2\) low\-income housing seekers (renters) who need affordable rent. Exchanges may be straight rent or a mix of rent plus up to 10 hours a week in light services such as transportation, cooking, or cleaning. Rental arrangements average $700 a month and services arrangements average $200/month plus services. The average duration of each match is 2 years with the longest match at 10\+ years. Our eldest participant, Shirley, who is 105 years old, was featured in Vice News' report about ALA's Shared Housing program. You may find the video here: https://youtu.be/KeIm2zBYRoM?si\=ehr\-OMBkKp9la\_Nm
